import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations.operator_space
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations.metric_entropy
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_03_operator_local_degeneracy.component_partition
import Mathlib.Data.ENNReal.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Set.Image
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Basic

set_option linter.style.longLine false

namespace formal_oet.vol_01.ch_03_operator_local_degeneracy

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations

noncomputable section

variable {X I : Type} {bot : X}
local instance instDecidableEqIComputationalFiber : DecidableEq I := Classical.decEq I
variable (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)

/-- 非空有限子族 -/
abbrev NonemptyFinset (I : Type) := { J : Finset I // J.Nonempty }


/-- 单元素非空子族 -/
def singleton_nonempty_finset (j : I) : NonemptyFinset I := ⟨{j}, Finset.singleton_nonempty j⟩

/-- 全指标非空子族。 -/
def full_nonempty_finset [Fintype I] [Nonempty I] : NonemptyFinset I :=
  ⟨Finset.univ, Finset.univ_nonempty⟩

/--
OET anchor: h-77b9589cc080d4f0
**定义（子族复合伪度量）**
$d_J(x, y) := \max_{j \in J} d_j(x, y)$
-/
def comp_pseudo_metric (J : NonemptyFinset I) (x y : X) : ENNReal :=
  J.val.sup (fun j => d j x y)

/-- 有限子族上的最大复合伪度量等于基础章定义的子族复合伪度量。 -/
theorem comp_pseudo_metric_eq_subfamily (J : NonemptyFinset I) :
    comp_pseudo_metric d J =
      subfamily_pseudometric d (↑J.val : Set I) := by
  funext x y
  apply le_antisymm
  · dsimp [comp_pseudo_metric, subfamily_pseudometric]
    apply Finset.sup_le
    intro j hj
    exact le_iSup_of_le ⟨j, hj⟩ le_rfl
  · dsimp [comp_pseudo_metric, subfamily_pseudometric]
    apply iSup_le
    intro j
    exact Finset.le_sup (f := fun k => d k x y) j.2

/-- A singleton finite subfamily recovers the selected component. -/
@[simp]
theorem comp_pseudo_metric_singleton (i : I) :
    comp_pseudo_metric d (singleton_nonempty_finset i) = d i := by
  funext x y
  dsimp [comp_pseudo_metric, singleton_nonempty_finset]
  simp

/--
复合伪度量 $d_J$ 等于 0 当且仅当子族中的每个测度均为 0。
-/
theorem comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff (J : NonemptyFinset I) (x y : X) :
    comp_pseudo_metric d J x y = 0 ↔ ∀ j ∈ J.val, d j x y = 0 := by
  dsimp [comp_pseudo_metric]
  exact Finset.sup_eq_bot_iff (fun j => d j x y) J.val

/--
OET anchor: h-77b9589cc080d4f0
**定义（计算纤维）**
$\operatorname{Fib}_{\phi, J}(y \mid U) := \{x \in U \mid d_J(\phi(x), y) = 0\}$
-/
def ComputationalFiber (ϕ : Operator X bot) (J : NonemptyFinset I) (U : Set X) (y : X) : Set X :=
  { x ∈ U | comp_pseudo_metric d J (ϕ.func x) y = 0 }

/--
OET anchor: h-8d9c504286a147a3
**命题（计算纤维的基本性质，(v)）- 单分量纤维**
单元素子族上的计算纤维就是对应单分量零距截面。
-/
theorem singleton_computational_fiber_eq (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (i : I) (y : X) :
    ComputationalFiber d ϕ (singleton_nonempty_finset i) U y =
      { x | x ∈ U ∧ d i (ϕ.func x) y = 0 } := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    constructor
    · exact hx.1
    · have h_all :=
        (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d (singleton_nonempty_finset i)
          (ϕ.func x) y).mp hx.2
      exact h_all i (Finset.mem_singleton.mpr rfl)
  · rintro ⟨hxU, hzero⟩
    constructor
    · exact hxU
    · apply (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d (singleton_nonempty_finset i)
        (ϕ.func x) y).mpr
      intro k hk
      have hk_eq : k = i := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hk
      simpa [hk_eq] using hzero

/--
OET anchor: h-8d9c504286a147a3
**命题（计算纤维的基本性质，(v)）- 全纤维包含单分量纤维**
全指标纤维包含于任意单分量纤维。
-/
theorem full_fiber_subset_singleton_fiber [Fintype I] [Nonempty I]
    (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (i : I) (y : X) :
    ComputationalFiber d ϕ (full_nonempty_finset : NonemptyFinset I) U y ⊆
      ComputationalFiber d ϕ (singleton_nonempty_finset i) U y := by
  intro x hx
  constructor
  · exact hx.1
  · apply (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d (singleton_nonempty_finset i)
      (ϕ.func x) y).mpr
    intro k hk
    have hk_eq : k = i := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hk
    rw [hk_eq]
    have h_all :=
      (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d (full_nonempty_finset : NonemptyFinset I)
        (ϕ.func x) y).mp hx.2
    exact h_all i (Finset.mem_univ i)

/--
OET anchor: h-8d9c504286a147a3
**命题（计算纤维的基本性质）- 分量交集律**
交集律：$\operatorname{Fib}_{\phi, J}(y \mid U) = \bigcap_{j \in J} \operatorname{Fib}_{\phi, j}(y \mid U)$
-/
theorem fiber_inter_law (ϕ : Operator X bot) (J : NonemptyFinset I) (U : Set X) (y : X) :
    ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U y = ⋂ j ∈ J.val, ComputationalFiber d ϕ (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U y := by
  ext x
  simp only [ComputationalFiber, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_iInter]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx_U, h_comp⟩
    intro j hj
    have h_zero : ∀ k ∈ J.val, d k (ϕ.func x) y = 0 := (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d J (ϕ.func x) y).mp h_comp
    constructor
    · exact hx_U
    · apply (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d (singleton_nonempty_finset j) (ϕ.func x) y).mpr
      intro k hk
      have hk_eq : k = j := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hk
      rw [hk_eq]
      exact h_zero j hj
  · intro h
    rcases J.prop with ⟨j0, hj0⟩
    have h_j0 := h j0 hj0
    have hx_U := h_j0.1
    constructor
    · exact hx_U
    · apply (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d J (ϕ.func x) y).mpr
      intro k hk
      have hk_eval := h k hk
      have h_zero := (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d (singleton_nonempty_finset k) (ϕ.func x) y).mp hk_eval.2
      exact h_zero k (Finset.mem_singleton.mpr rfl)

/--
OET anchor: h-8d9c504286a147a3
**命题（计算纤维的基本性质）- 子族单调性**
若 `J ⊆ K`，则 `K`-纤维包含于 `J`-纤维。
-/
theorem fiber_subset_of_index_subset (ϕ : Operator X bot) (J K : NonemptyFinset I)
    (U : Set X) (y : X) (hsub : J.val ⊆ K.val) :
    ComputationalFiber d ϕ K U y ⊆ ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U y := by
  intro x hx
  constructor
  · exact hx.1
  · apply (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d J (ϕ.func x) y).mpr
    intro j hj
    have h_all :=
      (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d K (ϕ.func x) y).mp hx.2
    exact h_all j (hsub hj)

/--
OET anchor: h-70882b889ff4ec94
**命题 #h-70882b889ff4ec94（纤维截断的单步判据，纤维成员形式）**
若 $y'$ 落入 $\phi(y)$ 的单分量计算纤维，则对应输出测距为零。
-/
theorem fiber_truncates_distance_of_mem (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (j : I) (y y' : X)
    (symm : ∀ x y : X, d j x y = d j y x)
    (hy'_fiber : y' ∈ ComputationalFiber d ϕ (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U (ϕ.func y)) :
    d j (ϕ.func y) (ϕ.func y') = 0 := by
  have h_zero_rev :
      d j (ϕ.func y') (ϕ.func y) = 0 := by
    have h_all :=
      (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d (singleton_nonempty_finset j)
        (ϕ.func y') (ϕ.func y)).mp hy'_fiber.2
    exact h_all j (Finset.mem_singleton.mpr rfl)
  rw [symm]
  exact h_zero_rev

/--
OET anchor: h-70882b889ff4ec94
**命题 #h-70882b889ff4ec94（纤维截断的单步判据，复合形式）**
若第一步像点落入第二步的计算纤维，则两步复合后的输出测距为零。
-/
theorem composed_fiber_truncates_distance (ϕ1 ϕ2 : Operator X bot) (U2 : Set X) (j : I) (x x' : X)
    (symm : ∀ a b : X, d j a b = d j b a)
    (hx_dom : x ∈ dom ϕ1)
    (hx'_dom : x' ∈ dom ϕ1)
    (hx_image : ϕ1.func x ∈ U2)
    (hx'_image : ϕ1.func x' ∈ U2)
    (h_fiber :
      ϕ1.func x' ∈
        ComputationalFiber d ϕ2 (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U2 (ϕ2.func (ϕ1.func x))) :
    d j (ϕ2.func (ϕ1.func x)) (ϕ2.func (ϕ1.func x')) = 0 := by
  have _ := hx_dom
  have _ := hx'_dom
  have _ := hx_image
  have _ := hx'_image
  exact fiber_truncates_distance_of_mem d ϕ2 U2 j (ϕ1.func x) (ϕ1.func x') symm h_fiber

/--
OET anchor: h-8d9c504286a147a3
**命题（计算纤维的基本性质）- 目标零距不变性**
等价纤维的不变性：若 $d_J(y, y') = 0$，则 $\operatorname{Fib}_{\phi, J}(y \mid U) = \operatorname{Fib}_{\phi, J}(y' \mid U)$
-/
theorem fiber_eq_of_comp_dist_zero (ϕ : Operator X bot) (J : NonemptyFinset I) (U : Set X) (y y' : X)
    (triangle : ∀ j x y z, d j x z ≤ d j x y + d j y z)
    (symm : ∀ j x y, d j x y = d j y x)
    (h_dist : comp_pseudo_metric d J y y' = 0) :
    ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U y = ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U y' := by
  ext x
  dsimp [ComputationalFiber]
  have h_zero : ∀ j ∈ J.val, d j y y' = 0 := (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d J y y').mp h_dist
  have h_y_y'_symm : ∀ j ∈ J.val, d j y' y = 0 := by
    intro j hj
    rw [symm]
    exact h_zero j hj
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx_U, h_comp⟩
    have h_x_y : ∀ j ∈ J.val, d j (ϕ.func x) y = 0 := (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d J (ϕ.func x) y).mp h_comp
    constructor
    · exact hx_U
    · apply (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d J (ϕ.func x) y').mpr
      intro j hj
      have h_le := triangle j (ϕ.func x) y y'
      rw [h_x_y j hj, h_zero j hj, add_zero] at h_le
      exact le_antisymm h_le (zero_le _)
  · rintro ⟨hx_U, h_comp⟩
    have h_x_y' : ∀ j ∈ J.val, d j (ϕ.func x) y' = 0 := (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d J (ϕ.func x) y').mp h_comp
    constructor
    · exact hx_U
    · apply (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d J (ϕ.func x) y).mpr
      intro j hj
      have h_le := triangle j (ϕ.func x) y' y
      rw [h_x_y' j hj, h_y_y'_symm j hj, add_zero] at h_le
      exact le_antisymm h_le (zero_le _)

/--
OET anchor: h-8d9c504286a147a3
**命题（计算纤维的基本性质）- 纤维覆盖**
计算纤维的分划属性：所有像点的纤维的并集覆盖整个区域 $U$。
-/
theorem fiber_partition (ϕ : Operator X bot) (J : NonemptyFinset I) (U : Set X)
    (self_dist_zero : ∀ j x, d j x x = 0) :
    ⋃ y ∈ ϕ.func '' U, ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U y = U := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
    rintro ⟨y, _, h_fib⟩
    exact h_fib.1
  · intro hx
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
    use ϕ.func x
    use Set.mem_image_of_mem ϕ.func hx
    dsimp [ComputationalFiber]
    constructor
    · exact hx
    · apply (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d J (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func x)).mpr
      intro j _
      exact self_dist_zero j (ϕ.func x)

/--
OET anchor: h-8d9c504286a147a3
**命题（计算纤维的基本性质）- 纤维互斥**
计算纤维的互斥属性：对于任意两个像点，其纤维要么相等，要么不交。
这保证了商空间的等价类互斥性。
-/
theorem fiber_disjoint (ϕ : Operator X bot) (J : NonemptyFinset I) (U : Set X)
    (triangle : ∀ i x y z, d i x z ≤ d i x y + d i y z)
    (symm : ∀ i x y, d i x y = d i y x) :
    ∀ y1 ∈ ϕ.func '' U, ∀ y2 ∈ ϕ.func '' U,
    ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U y1 = ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U y2 ∨
    Disjoint (ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U y1) (ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U y2) := by
  intro y1 _ y2 _
  by_cases h_comp : comp_pseudo_metric d J y1 y2 = 0
  · left
    exact fiber_eq_of_comp_dist_zero d ϕ J U y1 y2 triangle symm h_comp
  · right
    rw [Set.disjoint_iff]
    intro x hx
    have h1 := hx.1.2
    have h2 := hx.2.2
    have h_x_y1 : ∀ j ∈ J.val, d j (ϕ.func x) y1 = 0 := (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d J (ϕ.func x) y1).mp h1
    have h_x_y2 : ∀ j ∈ J.val, d j (ϕ.func x) y2 = 0 := (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d J (ϕ.func x) y2).mp h2
    have h_y1_y2 : ∀ j ∈ J.val, d j y1 y2 = 0 := by
      intro j hj
      have h_le := triangle j y1 (ϕ.func x) y2
      rw [symm j y1 (ϕ.func x), h_x_y1 j hj, h_x_y2 j hj, zero_add] at h_le
      exact le_antisymm h_le (zero_le _)
    have h_comp_zero : comp_pseudo_metric d J y1 y2 = 0 := (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d J y1 y2).mpr h_y1_y2
    exact False.elim (h_comp h_comp_zero)

/--
OET anchor: h-8d9c504286a147a3
**命题 #h-8d9c504286a147a3（计算纤维的基本性质）**

正文四个分支的同形最终定理。`J`、`K` 由 `NonemptyFinset` 同时编码有限性与非空性。
-/
theorem computational_fiber_partition_subfamily_monotonicity_textbook
    (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (hU : U ⊆ dom ϕ)
    (J K : NonemptyFinset I)
    (hmetric : ∀ i, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d i)) :
    (∀ y y', comp_pseudo_metric d J y y' = 0 →
      ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U y = ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U y') ∧
    ((⋃ y ∈ ϕ.func '' U, ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U y) = U ∧
      ∀ y₁ ∈ ϕ.func '' U, ∀ y₂ ∈ ϕ.func '' U,
        ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U y₁ = ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U y₂ ∨
          Disjoint (ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U y₁)
            (ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U y₂)) ∧
    (∀ y, ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U y =
      ⋂ j ∈ J.val, ComputationalFiber d ϕ (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U y) ∧
    (J.val ⊆ K.val → ∀ y,
      ComputationalFiber d ϕ K U y ⊆ ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U y) := by
  have _ := hU
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y y' hyy'
    exact fiber_eq_of_comp_dist_zero d ϕ J U y y'
      (fun i => (hmetric i).triangle) (fun i => (hmetric i).symm) hyy'
  · constructor
    · exact fiber_partition d ϕ J U (fun i => (hmetric i).dist_self)
    · exact fiber_disjoint d ϕ J U
        (fun i => (hmetric i).triangle) (fun i => (hmetric i).symm)
  · intro y
    exact fiber_inter_law d ϕ J U y
  · intro hJK y
    exact fiber_subset_of_index_subset d ϕ J K U y hJK

/--
OET anchor: h-ff54b8d36fa86c90
OET anchor: h-8d9c504286a147a3
**命题（恒等分量的纤维与零化半径）(i)**
同时支撑计算纤维基本性质中的恒等分量情形。
若 `i` 是恒等分量，则以 `ϕ(y)` 为目标的单分量计算纤维正是 `y` 的 `d_i` 零类在 `U` 中的截断。
-/
theorem id_component_singleton_fiber_eq_zero_class (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (i : I) (y : X)
    (hy : y ∈ U)
    (h_id : i ∈ IdComponent d ϕ U)
    (symm : ∀ x y : X, d i x y = d i y x)
    (triangle : ∀ x y z : X, d i x z ≤ d i x y + d i y z) :
    ComputationalFiber d ϕ (singleton_nonempty_finset i) U (ϕ.func y) =
      { x | x ∈ U ∧ d i x y = 0 } := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    constructor
    · exact hx.1
    · have hφxφy :
          d i (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) = 0 := by
        have h_all :=
          (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d (singleton_nonempty_finset i)
            (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y)).mp hx.2
        exact h_all i (Finset.mem_singleton.mpr rfl)
      have hxφx : d i x (ϕ.func x) = 0 := by
        rw [symm x (ϕ.func x)]
        exact h_id.2 x hx.1
      have hφy_y : d i (ϕ.func y) y = 0 := h_id.2 y hy
      have hφx_y : d i (ϕ.func x) y = 0 := by
        have h_le := triangle (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) y
        rw [hφxφy, hφy_y, zero_add] at h_le
        exact le_antisymm h_le (zero_le _)
      have h_le := triangle x (ϕ.func x) y
      rw [hxφx, hφx_y, zero_add] at h_le
      exact le_antisymm h_le (zero_le _)
  · rintro ⟨hxU, hxy⟩
    constructor
    · exact hxU
    · apply (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d (singleton_nonempty_finset i)
        (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y)).mpr
      intro k hk
      have hk_eq : k = i := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hk
      rw [hk_eq]
      have hφx_x : d i (ϕ.func x) x = 0 := h_id.2 x hxU
      have hy_φy : d i y (ϕ.func y) = 0 := by
        rw [symm y (ϕ.func y)]
        exact h_id.2 y hy
      have hx_φy : d i x (ϕ.func y) = 0 := by
        have h_le := triangle x y (ϕ.func y)
        rw [hxy, hy_φy, zero_add] at h_le
        exact le_antisymm h_le (zero_le _)
      have h_le := triangle (ϕ.func x) x (ϕ.func y)
      rw [hφx_x, hx_φy, zero_add] at h_le

theorem id_component_singleton_fiber_eq_zero_class_target
    (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (i : I) (y : X)
    (h_id : i ∈ IdComponent d ϕ U)
    (symm : ∀ x y : X, d i x y = d i y x)
    (triangle : ∀ x y z : X, d i x z ≤ d i x y + d i y z) :
    ComputationalFiber d ϕ (singleton_nonempty_finset i) U y =
      { x | x ∈ U ∧ d i x y = 0 } := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx

    · exact hx.1
    · have hφx_y : d i (ϕ.func x) y = 0 := by
        have h_all :=
          (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d (singleton_nonempty_finset i)
            (ϕ.func x) y).mp hx.2
        exact h_all i (Finset.mem_singleton.mpr rfl)
      have hx_φx : d i x (ϕ.func x) = 0 := by
        rw [symm x (ϕ.func x)]
        exact h_id.2 x hx.1
      have h_le := triangle x (ϕ.func x) y
      rw [hx_φx, hφx_y, zero_add] at h_le
      exact le_antisymm h_le (zero_le _)
  · rintro ⟨hxU, hxy⟩
    constructor
    · exact hxU
    · apply (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d (singleton_nonempty_finset i)
        (ϕ.func x) y).mpr
      intro k hk
      have hk_eq : k = i := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hk
      rw [hk_eq]
      have hφx_x : d i (ϕ.func x) x = 0 := h_id.2 x hxU
      have h_le := triangle (ϕ.func x) x y
      rw [hφx_x, hxy, zero_add] at h_le

**命题（计算纤维的基本性质，(vi)）- 常值分量的最大纤维**
常值分量在与常值像零距等价的目标上给出全集纤维。

theorem const_component_singleton_fiber_eq_univ_for_equiv_target
    (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (i : I) (u0 y : X)
    (hu0 : u0 ∈ U)
    (h_const : i ∈ ConstComponent d ϕ U)
    (triangle : ∀ x y z : X, d i x z ≤ d i x y + d i y z)
    (hy_equiv : d i (ϕ.func u0) y = 0) :
    ComputationalFiber d ϕ (singleton_nonempty_finset i) U y = U := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    exact hx.1
  · intro hxU
    constructor
    · exact hxU
    · apply (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d (singleton_nonempty_finset i)
        (ϕ.func x) y).mpr
      intro k hk
      have hk_eq : k = i := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hk
      rw [hk_eq]
      have h_const_zero : d i (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func u0) = 0 :=
        h_const x hxU u0 hu0
      have h_le := triangle (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func u0) y
      rw [h_const_zero, hy_equiv, zero_add] at h_le
      exact le_antisymm h_le (zero_le _)

theorem const_component_singleton_fiber_eq_empty_for_separated_target
    (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (i : I) (u0 y : X)
    (hu0 : u0 ∈ U)
    (h_const : i ∈ ConstComponent d ϕ U)
    (symm : ∀ x y : X, d i x y = d i y x)
    (triangle : ∀ x y z : X, d i x z ≤ d i x y + d i y z)
    (hy_pos : 0 < d i y (ϕ.func u0)) :
    ComputationalFiber d ϕ (singleton_nonempty_finset i) U y = ∅ := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have h_fib_zero : d i (ϕ.func x) y = 0 := by
      have h_all :=
        (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d (singleton_nonempty_finset i)
          (ϕ.func x) y).mp hx.2
      exact h_all i (Finset.mem_singleton.mpr rfl)
    have h_const_zero : d i (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func u0) = 0 :=
      h_const x hx.1 u0 hu0
    have h_y_φx : d i y (ϕ.func x) = 0 := by
      rw [symm y (ϕ.func x), h_fib_zero]
    have h_le := triangle y (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func u0)
    rw [h_y_φx, h_const_zero, zero_add] at h_le
    have h_zero : d i y (ϕ.func u0) = 0 := le_antisymm h_le (zero_le _)
    exact False.elim ((ne_of_gt hy_pos) h_zero)
  · intro hx
    exact False.elim hx

end

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations

open Finset
open scoped BigOperators

variable {X I : Type} {bot : X} [finite_I : Fintype I]
variable (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)

local instance instDecidableEqXMappingEntropy : DecidableEq X := Classical.decEq X
local instance instDecidableEqIMappingEntropy : DecidableEq I := Classical.decEq I

theorem log2_ereal_mono {x y : ENNReal} (h : x ≤ y) : log2_ereal x ≤ log2_ereal y := by
  dsimp [log2_ereal]
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · rw [if_pos hx]
    exact bot_le
  · rw [if_neg hx]
    by_cases hy : y = 0
    · rw [hy] at h
      have h_x0 : x = 0 := bot_unique h
      contradiction
    · rw [if_neg hy]
      by_cases hy_top : y = ⊤
      · rw [if_pos hy_top]
        exact le_top
      · rw [if_neg hy_top]
        by_cases hx_top : x = ⊤
        · rw [hx_top] at h
          have h_y_top : y = ⊤ := top_unique h
          contradiction
        · rw [if_neg hx_top]
          apply EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr
          dsimp [Real.logb]
          apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
          · apply Real.log_le_log
            · exact ENNReal.toReal_pos hx hx_top
            · exact ENNReal.toReal_mono hy_top h
          · apply le_of_lt
            exact Real.log_pos one_lt_two
theorem ereal_sub_le_sub_left {a b c : EReal} (h : a ≤ b) : c - b ≤ c - a := by
  exact EReal.sub_le_sub le_rfl h

@[simp]
theorem log2_ereal_one : log2_ereal (1 : ENNReal) = 0 := by
  norm_num [log2_ereal, Real.logb]

/-- 基础内覆盖在单分量伪度量上的特化。 -/
abbrev IsEpsilonNet (i : I) (ε : ENNReal) (U : Set X)
    (centers : Finset X) : Prop :=
  InternalEpsilonNet (d i) ε U centers

/-- 复合度量 $d_J$ 的 $\varepsilon$-覆盖网 -/
abbrev IsEpsilonNetComp (J : NonemptyFinset I) (ε : ENNReal)
    (U : Set X) (centers : Finset X) : Prop :=
  InternalEpsilonNet (comp_pseudo_metric d J) ε U centers

/-- 子族覆盖数 $\mathcal N_J(\varepsilon,U)$。 -/
noncomputable def cov_num_comp (J : NonemptyFinset I) (ε : ENNReal) (U : Set X) : ENNReal :=
  covering_number (comp_pseudo_metric d J) ε U

omit [Fintype I] in
/-- 有限子族记号给出的覆盖数等于对应子族复合伪度量的覆盖数。 -/
theorem cov_num_comp_eq_subfamily_covering_number
    (J : NonemptyFinset I) (ε : ENNReal) (U : Set X) :
    cov_num_comp d J ε U =
      covering_number
        (subfamily_pseudometric d (↑J.val : Set I)) ε U := by
  rw [cov_num_comp, comp_pseudo_metric_eq_subfamily]

omit [Fintype I] in
/-- The singleton subfamily covering number is the single-component one. -/
theorem cov_num_comp_singleton_eq_cov_num
    (i : I) (ε : ENNReal) (U : Set X) :
    cov_num_comp d (singleton_nonempty_finset i) ε U =
      covering_number (d i) ε U := by
  rw [cov_num_comp, comp_pseudo_metric_singleton]

omit [Fintype I] in
theorem cov_num_comp_le_of_epsilon_net (J : NonemptyFinset I) (ε : ENNReal) (U : Set X)
    (centers : Finset X) (hnet : IsEpsilonNetComp d J ε U centers) :
    cov_num_comp d J ε U ≤ (centers.card : ENNReal) := by
  dsimp [cov_num_comp]
  exact le_trans
    (iInf_le
      (fun centers : Finset X =>
        ⨅ (_ : IsEpsilonNetComp d J ε U centers), (centers.card : ENNReal))
      centers)
    (iInf_le
      (fun _ : IsEpsilonNetComp d J ε U centers => (centers.card : ENNReal))
      hnet)

/-- 覆盖数 $\mathcal{N}_i(\varepsilon, U)$，即基础覆盖数在单分量伪度量上的特化。 -/
noncomputable def cov_num (i : I) (ε : ENNReal) (U : Set X) : ENNReal :=
  covering_number (d i) ε U

omit [Fintype I] in
/-- A real-valued metric entropy has finite covering number. -/
theorem cov_num_lt_top_of_metric_entropy_eq_real
    (j : I) (ε : ENNReal) (U : Set X) (e : ℝ)
    (hentropy : metric_entropy (d j) ε U = (e : EReal)) :
    cov_num d j ε U < ⊤ := by
  apply lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr
  intro htop
  have hcover_top : covering_number (d j) ε U = ⊤ := by
    simpa [cov_num] using htop
  have hentropy_top : metric_entropy (d j) ε U = ⊤ := by
    simp [metric_entropy, log2_ereal, hcover_top]
  rw [hentropy_top] at hentropy
  exact EReal.coe_ne_top e hentropy.symm

omit [Fintype I] in
theorem cov_num_le_of_epsilon_net (i : I) (ε : ENNReal) (U : Set X)
    (centers : Finset X) (hnet : IsEpsilonNet d i ε U centers) :
    cov_num d i ε U ≤ (centers.card : ENNReal) := by
  dsimp [cov_num]
  exact le_trans
    (iInf_le (fun centers : Finset X => ⨅ (_ : IsEpsilonNet d i ε U centers), (centers.card : ENNReal)) centers)
    (iInf_le (fun _ : IsEpsilonNet d i ε U centers => (centers.card : ENNReal)) hnet)

omit [Fintype I] in
theorem one_le_cov_num_of_nonempty (i : I) (ε : ENNReal) (U : Set X)
    (hU : U.Nonempty) :
    (1 : ENNReal) ≤ cov_num d i ε U := by
  dsimp [cov_num]
  apply le_iInf
  intro centers
  apply le_iInf
  intro hnet
  rcases hU with ⟨x, hx⟩
  rcases hnet.2 x hx with ⟨c, hc, _⟩
  exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨c, hc⟩))

/--
OET anchor: h-56e96ed2cda64242
**命题（分量分划与映射熵差）- 零直径非空集合的覆盖数**
若非空集合中任意两点在分量 `i` 下零距，则其任意正精度覆盖数为 `1`。
-/
theorem cov_num_eq_one_of_nonempty_zero_diameter (i : I) (ε : ENNReal) (V : Set X)
    (hV : V.Nonempty)
    (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hzero : ∀ x ∈ V, ∀ y ∈ V, d i x y = 0) :
    cov_num d i ε V = 1 := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rcases hV with ⟨v0, hv0⟩
    let centers : Finset X := {v0}
    have hnet : IsEpsilonNet d i ε V centers := by
      dsimp [IsEpsilonNet, centers]
      constructor
      · intro x hx
        have hx_eq : x = v0 := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hx
        simpa [hx_eq] using hv0
      · intro x hx
        use v0
        constructor
        · exact Finset.mem_singleton.mpr rfl
        · rw [hzero x hx v0 hv0]
          exact hε
    have hle : cov_num d i ε V ≤ (centers.card : ENNReal) :=
      cov_num_le_of_epsilon_net d i ε V centers hnet
    simpa [centers] using hle
  · exact one_le_cov_num_of_nonempty d i ε V hV

/--
OET anchor: h-56e96ed2cda64242
**命题（分量分划与映射熵差）- 受限等距保持覆盖数**
若 `ϕ` 在 `U` 上保持分量 `i` 的点对距离，则像集与原集合的覆盖数相等。
-/
theorem cov_num_image_eq_of_component_distance_preserving
    (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (i : I) (ε : ENNReal)
    (hdist : ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, d i (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) = d i x y) :
    cov_num d i ε (ϕ.func '' U) = cov_num d i ε U := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · dsimp [cov_num]
    apply le_iInf
    intro centers_U
    apply le_iInf
    intro hnet_U
    let centers_V := centers_U.image ϕ.func
    have hnet_V : IsEpsilonNet d i ε (ϕ.func '' U) centers_V := by
      dsimp [IsEpsilonNet, centers_V] at hnet_U ⊢
      constructor
      · intro z hz
        rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_image] at hz
        rcases hz with ⟨u, hu, hzu⟩
        have huU : u ∈ U := hnet_U.1 hu
        rw [← hzu]
        exact Set.mem_image_of_mem ϕ.func huU
      · intro z hz
        rcases hz with ⟨x, hxU, hz_eq⟩
        rcases hnet_U.2 x hxU with ⟨c, hc, hc_lt⟩
        have hcU : c ∈ U := hnet_U.1 hc
        use ϕ.func c
        constructor
        · exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem ϕ.func hc
        · rw [← hz_eq, hdist x hxU c hcU]
          exact hc_lt
    have hle : cov_num d i ε (ϕ.func '' U) ≤ (centers_V.card : ENNReal) :=
      cov_num_le_of_epsilon_net d i ε (ϕ.func '' U) centers_V hnet_V
    exact le_trans hle (Nat.cast_le.mpr Finset.card_image_le)
  · dsimp [cov_num]
    apply le_iInf
    intro centers_V
    apply le_iInf
    intro hnet_V
    have h_ex : ∀ v ∈ centers_V, ∃ u ∈ U, ϕ.func u = v := by
      intro v hv
      have hv_image : v ∈ ϕ.func '' U := hnet_V.1 hv
      exact (Set.mem_image ϕ.func U v).mp hv_image
    let pre (v : X) (hv : v ∈ centers_V) : X := Classical.choose (h_ex v hv)
    have hpre : ∀ v (hv : v ∈ centers_V), pre v hv ∈ U ∧ ϕ.func (pre v hv) = v := by
      intro v hv
      exact Classical.choose_spec (h_ex v hv)
    let centers_U := centers_V.attach.image (fun v : {x // x ∈ centers_V} => pre v.val v.prop)
    have hnet_U : IsEpsilonNet d i ε U centers_U := by
      dsimp [IsEpsilonNet, centers_U]
      constructor
      · intro u hu
        rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_image] at hu
        rcases hu with ⟨v, _, huv⟩
        rw [← huv]
        exact (hpre v.val v.prop).1
      · intro x hxU
        have hφx : ϕ.func x ∈ ϕ.func '' U := Set.mem_image_of_mem ϕ.func hxU
        rcases hnet_V.2 (ϕ.func x) hφx with ⟨v, hv, hv_lt⟩
        use pre v hv
        constructor
        · rw [Finset.mem_image]
          exact ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, Finset.mem_attach centers_V ⟨v, hv⟩, rfl⟩
        · have hp := hpre v hv
          rw [← hdist x hxU (pre v hv) hp.1, hp.2]
          exact hv_lt
    have hle : cov_num d i ε U ≤ (centers_U.card : ENNReal) :=
      cov_num_le_of_epsilon_net d i ε U centers_U hnet_U
    have h_card : (centers_U.card : ENNReal) ≤ (centers_V.card : ENNReal) := by
      apply Nat.cast_le.mpr
      have h_attach : centers_V.attach.card = centers_V.card := Finset.card_attach
      rw [← h_attach]
      exact Finset.card_image_le
    exact le_trans hle h_card

theorem const_component_image_cov_num_eq_one
    (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (j : I) (ε : ENNReal)

theorem id_component_image_cov_num_eq
    (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (j : I) (ε : ENNReal)
    (h_id : j ∈ IdComponent d ϕ U)
    (symm : ∀ x y : X, d j x y = d j y x)

有限集在正精度下具有有限覆盖数。

theorem cov_num_lt_top_of_finite (i : I) (ε : ENNReal) (U : Set X)
    (hU_fin : U.Finite)
    (hε : 0 < ε)
    (self_dist_zero : ∀ z, d i z z = 0) :
    cov_num d i ε U < ⊤ := by
  let centers := hU_fin.toFinset
  have hnet : IsEpsilonNet d i ε U centers := by
    dsimp [IsEpsilonNet, centers]
    constructor
    · intro x hx
      exact (hU_fin.mem_toFinset.mp hx)
    · intro x hx
      use x
      constructor
      · exact hU_fin.mem_toFinset.mpr hx
      · rw [self_dist_zero x]
        exact hε
  have hle : cov_num d i ε U ≤ (centers.card : ENNReal) :=
    cov_num_le_of_epsilon_net d i ε U centers hnet

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in

/--
OET anchor: h-f4a4cb93f576325e
**注（有限集上映射熵差的良定性）- 子族覆盖数有限**
有限集在任意非空有限子族的复合伪度量下具有有限覆盖数。
-/
theorem cov_num_comp_lt_top_of_finite (J : NonemptyFinset I) (ε : ENNReal) (U : Set X)
    (hU_fin : U.Finite)
    (hε : 0 < ε)
    (self_dist_zero : ∀ j z, d j z z = 0) :
    cov_num_comp d J ε U < ⊤ := by
  let centers := hU_fin.toFinset
  have hnet : IsEpsilonNetComp d J ε U centers := by
    dsimp [IsEpsilonNetComp, centers]
    constructor
    · intro x hx
      exact hU_fin.mem_toFinset.mp hx
    · intro x hx
      use x
      constructor
      · exact hU_fin.mem_toFinset.mpr hx
      · apply lt_of_le_of_lt _ hε

  intro h_net_V

    intro v hv
    have hv_in : v ∈ ϕ.func '' U := h_net_V.1 hv
    exact (Set.mem_image ϕ.func U v).mp hv_in

  have h_inv_prop : ∀ v (hv : v ∈ centers_V), inv_f v hv ∈ U ∧ ϕ.func (inv_f v hv) = v := by

      rw [← hv_eq]

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
set_option linter.unusedFintypeInType false in
omit [Fintype I] in
/--
OET anchor: h-9ecc7d0b4b541992
**命题 #h-9ecc7d0b4b541992（零测距纤维包含推出覆盖数约束）**
把任意输入 `τ`-内网经算子取像，即得到输出像的 `ε`-内网；因此不需要
假设最优内网存在。
-/
theorem zeroing_cov_num_le (φ : Operator X bot) (A : Set X)
    (i j : I) (τ ε : ENNReal) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hzero : ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ A,
      d i y x < τ → d j (φ.func y) (φ.func x) = 0) :
    cov_num d j ε (φ.func '' A) ≤ cov_num d i τ A := by
  classical
  dsimp [cov_num, covering_number]
  apply le_iInf
  intro centers
  apply le_iInf
  intro hnet
  have h_image_net :
      InternalEpsilonNet (d j) ε (φ.func '' A) (centers.image φ.func) := by
    constructor
    · intro z hz
      rw [Finset.coe_image] at hz
      rcases hz with ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
      exact Set.mem_image_of_mem φ.func (hnet.1 hc)
    · rintro z ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      rcases hnet.2 x hx with ⟨c, hc, hxc⟩
      refine ⟨φ.func c, Finset.mem_image_of_mem φ.func hc, ?_⟩
      have hφzero : d j (φ.func x) (φ.func c) = 0 :=
        hzero c (hnet.1 hc) x hx hxc
      simpa [hφzero] using hε
  calc
    (⨅ (image_centers : Finset X)
        (_ : InternalEpsilonNet (d j) ε (φ.func '' A) image_centers),
        (image_centers.card : ENNReal)) ≤
        ((centers.image φ.func).card : ENNReal) := by
      exact iInf_le_of_le (centers.image φ.func)
        (iInf_le_of_le h_image_net le_rfl)
    _ ≤ (centers.card : ENNReal) := by
      exact_mod_cast Finset.card_image_le

omit [Fintype I] in
/-- OET anchor: h-9ecc7d0b4b541992
统一零化半径下界给出任意子集的内部覆盖数约束；不要求全有界或有限零化半径。 -/
theorem operator_zero_radius_cov_num_bound
    (φ : Operator X bot) (A B : Set X) (hBA : B ⊆ A)
    (i j : I) (τ ε : ENNReal) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hν : τ ≤ min_annihilation_radius d φ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) A) :
    cov_num d j ε (φ.func '' B) ≤ cov_num d i τ B := by
  apply zeroing_cov_num_le d φ B i j τ ε hε
  intro x hx y hy hdist
  exact zero_of_lt_min_annihilation_radius d φ A i j x y τ hν (hBA hx) (hBA hy) hdist

omit [Fintype I] in
/-- OET anchor: h-9ecc7d0b4b541992
一般覆盖数上界经对数单调性给出度量熵上界；正文使用非空且熵有定义的子集。 -/
theorem operator_zero_radius_metric_entropy_bound
    (φ : Operator X bot) (A B : Set X) (hBA : B ⊆ A)
    (i j : I) (τ ε : ENNReal) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hν : τ ≤ min_annihilation_radius d φ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) A) :
    metric_entropy (d j) ε (φ.func '' B) ≤ metric_entropy (d i) τ B := by
  exact log2_ereal_mono
    (operator_zero_radius_cov_num_bound d φ A B hBA i j τ ε hε hν)

omit [Fintype I] in
/-- OET anchor: h-610f439b6ff59f79
小输入域上的整体零化判据. Every positive finite output precision has
internal covering number one on the actual output domain. -/
theorem joint_zeroing_cov_num_eq_one
    (φ : Operator X bot) (A : Set X) (hA : A.Nonempty) (i j : I) (τ_σ τ_ν : ENNReal)
    (hdiam : input_diameter d i (A) < τ_σ)
    (hthreshold : τ_σ ≤ τ_ν)
    (hν : τ_ν ≤ min_annihilation_radius d φ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) A)
    (ε : ENNReal) (hε : FinitePositiveRadius ε) :
    cov_num d j ε (φ.func '' A) = 1 := by
  apply cov_num_eq_one_of_nonempty_zero_diameter d j ε _
    (hA.image φ.func) hε.1
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  exact (joint_zeroing_iff d φ A i j τ_σ τ_ν hdiam hthreshold).mp hν x hx y hy


omit [Fintype I] in
/--
**代数辅助引理（零化半径给出的输出熵上界）**
-/
theorem resolution_limit_annihilation_bound_aux (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (i j : I) (ν ε : ENNReal)
    (h_nu : min_annihilation_radius d ϕ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U = ν)
    (h_eps_pos : 0 < ε) :
    cov_num d j ε (ϕ.func '' U) ≤ cov_num d i ν U := by
  apply operator_zero_radius_cov_num_bound d ϕ U U (Set.Subset.refl U) i j ν ε h_eps_pos
  exact le_of_eq h_nu.symm


set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
set_option linter.unusedFintypeInType false in
/--
OET anchor: h-e9598cebcf324e28
**推论 #h-e9598cebcf324e28（零化半径给出的输出熵上界）**
-/
theorem resolution_limit_annihilation_bound_exact (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (i j : I) (ν ε : ENNReal)
    (_h_dom : U ⊆ dom ϕ)
    (_h_nempty : U.Nonempty)
    (h_nu_val : min_annihilation_radius d ϕ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U = ν)
    (h_nu_pos : 0 < ν)
    (h_nu_ne_top : ν ≠ ⊤)
    (h_eps_pos : 0 < ε)
    (_h_eps_ne_top : ε ≠ ⊤)
    (h_tb : IsTotallyBounded d i U) :
    cov_num d i ν U < ⊤ ∧
    log2_ereal (cov_num d j ε (ϕ.func '' U)) ≤ log2_ereal (cov_num d i ν U) := by
  constructor
  · exact h_tb ν h_nu_pos h_nu_ne_top
  · have h_cov := resolution_limit_annihilation_bound_aux d ϕ U i j ν ε h_nu_val h_eps_pos
    exact log2_ereal_mono h_cov

end

files.content:
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_03_operator_local_degeneracy.annihilation_matrix
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations.metric_entropy
import Mathlib.Tactic

namespace formal_oet.vol_01.ch_03_operator_local_degeneracy

noncomputable section

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds

variable {X I : Type} {bot : X}
variable (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
local instance : DecidableEq I := Classical.decEq I

/--
OET anchor: h-83287e414000b50b **定义（阈值分类）**
Two independent bits: the first records input scale below its threshold;
the second records zeroing radius at least its threshold. `true` represents 1.
-/
abbrev ThresholdBits := Bool × Bool

/--
OET anchor: h-83287e414000b50b
**定义（输入尺度函数族）**
尺度值只在非空集合上承载正文语义；`val` 在空集上的值是无约束的全域代表。
-/
structure ScaleFamily (X I : Type) where
  val : I → Set X → ENNReal
  monotone : ∀ (i : I) {A₁ A₂ : Set X},
    A₁.Nonempty → A₂.Nonempty → A₁ ⊆ A₂ → val i A₁ ≤ val i A₂

instance : CoeFun (ScaleFamily X I) (fun _ => I → Set X → ENNReal) where
  coe σ := σ.val

/-- OET anchor: h-83287e414000b50b
一般算子在受限域上的阈值分类。正文使用非空 `A ⊆ dom φ` 和两个有限正阈值；
公式本身对任意域和扩展阈值有定义，且两个坐标互不遮蔽。 -/
noncomputable def operator_threshold_readout (φ : Operator X bot) (A : Set X)
    (σ : ScaleFamily X I) (τ_σ τ_ν : ENNReal) (i j : I) : ThresholdBits := by
  classical
  exact (decide (σ i A < τ_σ),
    decide (τ_ν ≤ min_annihilation_radius d φ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) A))

/-- OET anchor: h-76dc176ee249f20a
The input bit is 1 exactly when the input scale is below its threshold. -/
theorem operator_input_bit_eq_true_iff (σ : ScaleFamily (X := X) (I := I))
    (τ_σ τ_ν : ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot) (A : Set X) (i j : I) :
    (operator_threshold_readout d φ A σ τ_σ τ_ν i j).1 = true ↔
      σ i A < τ_σ := by
  classical
  simp [operator_threshold_readout]

/-- OET anchor: h-76dc176ee249f20a
The input bit is 0 exactly when the input scale reaches its threshold. -/
theorem operator_input_bit_eq_false_iff (σ : ScaleFamily (X := X) (I := I))
    (τ_σ τ_ν : ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot) (A : Set X) (i j : I) :
    (operator_threshold_readout d φ A σ τ_σ τ_ν i j).1 = false ↔
      τ_σ ≤ σ i A := by
  classical
  simp [operator_threshold_readout]

/-- OET anchor: h-76dc176ee249f20a
The zeroing bit is 1 exactly when the zeroing radius reaches its threshold,
regardless of the input-scale bit. -/
theorem operator_zero_bit_eq_true_iff (σ : ScaleFamily (X := X) (I := I))
    (τ_σ τ_ν : ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot) (A : Set X) (i j : I) :
    (operator_threshold_readout d φ A σ τ_σ τ_ν i j).2 = true ↔
      τ_ν ≤ min_annihilation_radius d φ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) A := by
  classical
  simp [operator_threshold_readout]

/-- OET anchor: h-76dc176ee249f20a
The zeroing bit is 0 exactly when the zeroing radius is below its threshold. -/
theorem operator_zero_bit_eq_false_iff (σ : ScaleFamily (X := X) (I := I))
    (τ_σ τ_ν : ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot) (A : Set X) (i j : I) :
    (operator_threshold_readout d φ A σ τ_σ τ_ν i j).2 = false ↔
      min_annihilation_radius d φ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) A < τ_ν := by
  classical
  simp [operator_threshold_readout]

/-- OET anchor: h-76dc176ee249f20a
Every readout is one of the four Boolean pairs. -/
theorem operator_threshold_readout_exhaustive (σ : ScaleFamily (X := X) (I := I))
    (τ_σ τ_ν : ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot) (A : Set X) (i j : I) :
    operator_threshold_readout d φ A σ τ_σ τ_ν i j = (false, false) ∨
      operator_threshold_readout d φ A σ τ_σ τ_ν i j = (false, true) ∨
      operator_threshold_readout d φ A σ τ_σ τ_ν i j = (true, false) ∨
      operator_threshold_readout d φ A σ τ_σ τ_ν i j = (true, true) := by
  cases h : operator_threshold_readout d φ A σ τ_σ τ_ν i j with
  | mk a b => cases a <;> cases b <;> simp

/-- OET anchor: h-76dc176ee249f20a
Increasing the input threshold preserves a true input bit. -/
theorem operator_input_bit_monotone (σ : ScaleFamily (X := X) (I := I))
    {τ₁ τ₂ τ_ν : ENNReal} (hτ : τ₁ ≤ τ₂)
    {φ : Operator X bot} {A : Set X} {i j : I}
    (hinput : (operator_threshold_readout d φ A σ τ₁ τ_ν i j).1 = true) :
    (operator_threshold_readout d φ A σ τ₂ τ_ν i j).1 = true := by
  have hscale := (operator_input_bit_eq_true_iff d σ τ₁ τ_ν φ A i j).mp hinput
  exact (operator_input_bit_eq_true_iff d σ τ₂ τ_ν φ A i j).mpr
    (lt_of_lt_of_le hscale hτ)

/-- OET anchor: h-76dc176ee249f20a
A true zeroing bit at a larger threshold remains true at a smaller threshold. -/
theorem operator_zero_bit_antitone (σ : ScaleFamily (X := X) (I := I))
    {τ_σ τ₁ τ₂ : ENNReal} (hτ : τ₁ ≤ τ₂)
    {φ : Operator X bot} {A : Set X} {i j : I}
    (hzero : (operator_threshold_readout d φ A σ τ_σ τ₂ i j).2 = true) :
    (operator_threshold_readout d φ A σ τ_σ τ₁ i j).2 = true := by
  have hν := (operator_zero_bit_eq_true_iff d σ τ_σ τ₂ φ A i j).mp hzero
  exact (operator_zero_bit_eq_true_iff d σ τ_σ τ₁ φ A i j).mpr (le_trans hτ hν)

/-- A zeroing radius valid on a larger domain remains valid after restricting
the domain, so the restricted minimum radius cannot decrease. -/
theorem annihilation_localization_radius_mono
    (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U D : Set X) (i j : I)
    (hUD : U ⊆ D) :
    min_annihilation_radius d ϕ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) D ≤
      min_annihilation_radius d ϕ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U := by
  dsimp [min_annihilation_radius]
  apply le_iInf
  intro y
  apply le_iInf
  intro hyU
  have h_inf_D_le_ann_D :
      (⨅ z ∈ D, annihilation_radius d ϕ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) D z) ≤
        annihilation_radius d ϕ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) D y :=
    iInf₂_le y (hUD hyU)
  have h_ann_D_le_ann_U :
      annihilation_radius d ϕ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) D y ≤
        annihilation_radius d ϕ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U y := by
    dsimp [annihilation_radius]
    apply iSup_le
    intro r
    apply iSup_le
    intro hr
    apply iSup_le
    intro h_sub_D
    apply le_iSup_of_le r
    apply le_iSup_of_le hr
    have h_sub_U :
        OpenBall d i y r ∩ U ⊆
          ComputationalFiber d ϕ (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U (ϕ.func y) := by
      intro x hx
      have hxD : x ∈ OpenBall d i y r ∩ D := ⟨hx.1, hUD hx.2⟩
      have h_fib_D := h_sub_D hxD
      exact ⟨hx.2, h_fib_D.2⟩
    exact le_iSup_of_le h_sub_U le_rfl
  exact le_trans h_inf_D_le_ann_D h_ann_D_le_ann_U

/-- OET anchor: h-451ca2134cd62db4
域缩小下的输入尺度不增。此结论只用尺度函数族定义中的非空域单调性。 -/
theorem input_scale_mono_of_subset (σ : ScaleFamily X I) (i : I)
    {A B : Set X} (hB : B.Nonempty) (hBA : B ⊆ A) : σ i B ≤ σ i A :=
  σ.monotone i hB (hB.mono hBA) hBA

/--
OET anchor: h-451ca2134cd62db4
**命题 #h-451ca2134cd62db4（域缩小下的尺度与统一零化半径单调性）**
若输入尺度关于集合包含单调，则 输入尺度低于阈值的条件沿子域继承。
-/
theorem input_scale_lt_of_subset
    (scale : Set X → ENNReal) (tau : ENNReal)
    {B Bα : Set X}
    (hmono : ∀ {A₁ A₂ : Set X}, A₁ ⊆ A₂ → scale A₁ ≤ scale A₂)
    (hsub : Bα ⊆ B)
    (hscale : scale B < tau) :
    scale Bα < tau :=
  lt_of_le_of_lt (hmono hsub) hscale

/--
OET anchor: h-451ca2134cd62db4
**命题 #h-451ca2134cd62db4（域缩小下的尺度与统一零化半径单调性）**
有限分划中的每个胞只使用其为母域子集这一事实继承 输入尺度低于阈值的条件。
-/
theorem input_scale_lt_of_partition_cell
    (scale : Set X → ENNReal) (tau : ENNReal)
    {B : Set X} {F : Type} (cell : F → Set X)
    (hmono : ∀ {A₁ A₂ : Set X}, A₁ ⊆ A₂ → scale A₁ ≤ scale A₂)
    (hcell : ∀ α : F, cell α ⊆ B)
    (hscale : scale B < tau) :
    ∀ α : F, scale (cell α) < tau := by
  intro α
  exact input_scale_lt_of_subset scale tau hmono (hcell α) hscale

/--
OET anchor: h-451ca2134cd62db4
**命题 #h-451ca2134cd62db4（域缩小下的尺度与统一零化半径单调性）**
输入尺度函数族自身的单调性给出 输入尺度低于阈值的条件沿子域继承。
-/
theorem input_scale_lt_of_subset_scale_family
    (σ : ScaleFamily X I) (i : I) (tau : ENNReal)
    {U Uα : Set X}
    (hUα_nonempty : Uα.Nonempty) (hU_nonempty : U.Nonempty)
    (hsub : Uα ⊆ U)
    (hscale : σ i U < tau) :
    σ i Uα < tau :=
  lt_of_le_of_lt (σ.monotone i hUα_nonempty hU_nonempty hsub) hscale

/--
OET anchor: h-451ca2134cd62db4
**命题 #h-451ca2134cd62db4（域缩小下的尺度与统一零化半径单调性）**
有限分划中的每个胞由输入尺度函数族单调性继承 输入尺度低于阈值的条件。
-/
theorem input_scale_lt_of_partition_cell_scale_family
    (σ : ScaleFamily X I) (i : I) (tau : ENNReal)
    {U : Set X} {F : Type} (cell : F → Set X)
    (hU_nonempty : U.Nonempty)
    (hcell_nonempty : ∀ α : F, (cell α).Nonempty)
    (hcell : ∀ α : F, cell α ⊆ U)
    (hscale : σ i U < tau) :
    ∀ α : F, σ i (cell α) < tau := by
  intro α
  exact input_scale_lt_of_subset_scale_family σ i tau
    (hcell_nonempty α) hU_nonempty (hcell α) hscale

/--
OET anchor: h-451ca2134cd62db4
**命题 #h-451ca2134cd62db4（域缩小下的尺度与统一零化半径单调性）**
对同一局域算子，统一零化半径沿子域限制单调不减。
-/
theorem zero_radius_mono_of_subset
    (ϕ : Operator X bot) {B Bα : Set X} (i j : I)
    (hsub : Bα ⊆ B) :
    min_annihilation_radius d ϕ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) B ≤
      min_annihilation_radius d ϕ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) Bα :=
  annihilation_localization_radius_mono d ϕ Bα B i j hsub

/--
OET anchor: h-451ca2134cd62db4
**命题 #h-451ca2134cd62db4（域缩小下的尺度与统一零化半径单调性）**
`Fin 3` 上由两个非吸收代表给出的两点直径尺度。
-/
noncomputable def fin3_two_point_diam_scale (A : Set (Fin 3)) : ENNReal := by
  classical
  exact if (1 : Fin 3) ∈ A ∧ (2 : Fin 3) ∈ A then 1 else 0

/--
OET anchor: h-451ca2134cd62db4
**命题 #h-451ca2134cd62db4（域缩小下的尺度与统一零化半径单调性）**
该输入尺度关于集合包含单调。
-/
theorem fin3_two_point_diam_scale_monotone :
    ∀ A B : Set (Fin 3), A ⊆ B →
      fin3_two_point_diam_scale A ≤ fin3_two_point_diam_scale B := by
  classical
  intro A B hAB
  unfold fin3_two_point_diam_scale
  by_cases hA : (1 : Fin 3) ∈ A ∧ (2 : Fin 3) ∈ A
  · have hB : (1 : Fin 3) ∈ B ∧ (2 : Fin 3) ∈ B :=
      ⟨hAB hA.1, hAB hA.2⟩
    simp [hA, hB]
  · by_cases hB : (1 : Fin 3) ∈ B ∧ (2 : Fin 3) ∈ B <;> simp [hA, hB]

/--
OET anchor: h-451ca2134cd62db4
**命题 #h-451ca2134cd62db4（域缩小下的尺度与统一零化半径单调性）**
输入尺度低于阈值的条件的反向一般不成立：子域可低于阈值而母域不低于阈值。
-/
theorem input_scale_lt_reverse_fails_under_refinement :
    ({(1 : Fin 3)} : Set (Fin 3)) ⊆ ({(1 : Fin 3), (2 : Fin 3)} : Set (Fin 3)) ∧
      fin3_two_point_diam_scale ({(1 : Fin 3)} : Set (Fin 3)) < (1 / 2 : ENNReal) ∧
        ¬ fin3_two_point_diam_scale
          ({(1 : Fin 3), (2 : Fin 3)} : Set (Fin 3)) < (1 / 2 : ENNReal) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Fin.isValue, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx ⊢
    exact Or.inl hx
  constructor
  · have h21 : (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 1 := by decide
    norm_num [fin3_two_point_diam_scale, h21]
  · norm_num [fin3_two_point_diam_scale]

/--
OET anchor: h-9ecc7d0b4b541992
**命题 #h-9ecc7d0b4b541992（零化阈值下的纤维包含与覆盖数约束，半径抽取）**
从统一零化半径下界与严格距离条件推出单分量零测距。
-/
theorem zero_of_lt_min_annihilation_radius (φ : Operator X bot)
    (U : Set X) (i j : I) (x y : X) (τ : ENNReal)
    (hτ : τ ≤ min_annihilation_radius d φ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U)
    (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ U) (hxy : d i y x < τ) :
    d j (φ.func y) (φ.func x) = 0 := by
  have h_inf_le :
      min_annihilation_radius d φ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U ≤
        annihilation_radius d φ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U x :=
    iInf₂_le x hx
  have hlt :
      d i y x <
        annihilation_radius d φ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U x :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hxy (le_trans hτ h_inf_le)
  rcases lt_iSup_iff.mp hlt with ⟨r, hr⟩
  rcases lt_iSup_iff.mp hr with ⟨hr_fin, hr'⟩
  rcases lt_iSup_iff.mp hr' with ⟨hsub, hyr⟩
  have hy_ball : y ∈ OpenBall d i x r ∩ U := ⟨hyr, hy⟩
  have hy_fiber := hsub hy_ball
  have hzero :=
    (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d (singleton_nonempty_finset j)
      (φ.func y) (φ.func x)).mp hy_fiber.2
  exact hzero j (Finset.mem_singleton.mpr rfl)

/--
OET anchor: h-6ad76403c3bfeb84
**命题 #h-6ad76403c3bfeb84（统一零化半径给出的分离阈值，低于统一零化半径必归零）**
低于受限算子的统一零化半径时，输出在对应分量上零测距。
-/
theorem zero_of_lt_zero_radius
    (φ : Operator X bot) (A : Set X) (i j : I) (x y : X)
    (hx : x ∈ A)
    (hy : y ∈ A)
    (hxy : d i y x < min_annihilation_radius d φ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) A) :
    d j (φ.func y)
      (φ.func x) = 0 :=
  zero_of_lt_min_annihilation_radius d φ
    A i j x y
    (min_annihilation_radius d φ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) A) le_rfl hx hy hxy

/--
OET anchor: h-6ad76403c3bfeb84
**命题 #h-6ad76403c3bfeb84（统一零化半径给出的分离阈值，输出正分离时的输入距离下界）**
若受限算子的输出在目标分量上正分离，则输入距离不低于统一零化半径。
-/
theorem zero_radius_le_of_output_pos
    (φ : Operator X bot) (A : Set X) (i j : I) (x y : X)
    (hx : x ∈ A)
    (hy : y ∈ A)
    (hpos : 0 < d j (φ.func y)
      (φ.func x)) :
    min_annihilation_radius d φ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) A ≤ d i y x := by
  by_contra hnot
  have hlt : d i y x < min_annihilation_radius d φ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) A :=
    not_le.mp hnot
  have hzero := zero_of_lt_zero_radius d φ A i j x y hx hy hlt
  exact (ne_of_gt hpos) hzero

/--
OET anchor: h-6ad76403c3bfeb84
**命题 #h-6ad76403c3bfeb84（统一零化半径给出的分离阈值，低零化半径下的亚阈值输出分离见证）**
Every finite positive scale strictly above the local zeroing radius and below
its threshold admits a positive output separation. The interval premise already
implies that the zeroing radius is below the threshold.
-/
theorem subthreshold_separation_witness
    (τ_ν : ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot) (A : Set X) (i j : I)
    (α : ENNReal)
    (hα_between : min_annihilation_radius d φ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) A < α ∧ α < τ_ν)
    (hα_fin : FinitePositiveRadius α) :
    ∃ x ∈ A,
      ∃ y ∈ A,
        ∃ ε : ENNReal,
          FinitePositiveRadius ε ∧
            d i x y < α ∧
              ε ≤ d j (φ.func x)
                (φ.func y) := by
  classical
  have hzero_lt : min_annihilation_radius d φ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) A < α := hα_between.1
  dsimp [min_annihilation_radius] at hzero_lt
  have hy_exists :
      ∃ y ∈ A,
        annihilation_radius d φ i
          (singleton_nonempty_finset j) A y < α := by
    by_contra hnone
    have hall :
        ∀ y, y ∈ A →
          α ≤ annihilation_radius d φ i
            (singleton_nonempty_finset j) A y := by
      intro y hy
      exact le_of_not_gt (by
        intro hlt
        exact hnone ⟨y, hy, hlt⟩)
    have hle_inf :
        α ≤
          ⨅ y, ⨅ _hy : y ∈ A,
            annihilation_radius d φ i
              (singleton_nonempty_finset j) A y := by
      exact le_iInf (fun y => le_iInf (fun hy => hall y hy))
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hle_inf) hzero_lt
  rcases hy_exists with ⟨y, hy, hy_ann_lt⟩
  by_contra hnot
  have h_ball_sub :
      OpenBall d i y α ∩ A ⊆
        ComputationalFiber d φ
          (singleton_nonempty_finset j) A
          (φ.func y) := by
    intro x hx
    by_contra hxfib
    have hdist_pos :
        0 < d j (φ.func x)
          (φ.func y) := by
      have hdist_ne :
          d j (φ.func x)
            (φ.func y) ≠ 0 := by
        intro hzero
        apply hxfib
        refine ⟨hx.2, ?_⟩
        apply (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d (singleton_nonempty_finset j)
          (φ.func x)
          (φ.func y)).mpr
        intro k hk
        have hk_eq : k = j := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hk
        simpa [hk_eq] using hzero
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne' (zero_le _) hdist_ne
    let ε : ENNReal :=
      min (d j (φ.func x)
        (φ.func y)) 1
    have hε_pos : 0 < ε := by
      exact lt_min hdist_pos (by norm_num)
    have hε_ne_top : ε ≠ ⊤ := by
      exact ne_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) ENNReal.one_lt_top)
    have hε_le :
        ε ≤ d j (φ.func x)
          (φ.func y) :=
      min_le_left _ _
    apply hnot
    refine ⟨x, hx.2, y, hy, ε, ⟨⟨hε_pos, hε_ne_top⟩, ?_, hε_le⟩⟩
    exact hx.1
  have hα_le_ann :
      α ≤ annihilation_radius d φ i
        (singleton_nonempty_finset j) A y :=
    le_iSup_of_le α (le_iSup_of_le hα_fin (le_iSup_of_le h_ball_sub le_rfl))
  exact (not_le_of_gt hy_ann_lt) hα_le_ann

/--
OET anchor: h-9ecc7d0b4b541992
**命题 #h-9ecc7d0b4b541992（零化阈值下的纤维包含与覆盖数约束，纤维包含）**
零化半径下界在当前输入域上给出半径 `τ_ν` 的单分量计算纤维包含。
-/
theorem zero_radius_fiber_inclusion
    (τ_ν : ENNReal) (φ : Operator X bot) (A : Set X) (i j : I)
    (hν : τ_ν ≤ min_annihilation_radius d φ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) A) :
    ∀ x ∈ A,
      OpenBall d i x τ_ν ∩ A ⊆
        ComputationalFiber d φ (singleton_nonempty_finset j)
          A
          (φ.func x) := by
  intro x hx y hy
  refine ⟨hy.2, ?_⟩
  apply (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d (singleton_nonempty_finset j)
    (φ.func y)
    (φ.func x)).mpr
  intro k hk
  have hk_eq : k = j := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hk
  rw [hk_eq]
  exact zero_of_lt_min_annihilation_radius d φ
    A
    i j x y τ_ν hν hx hy.2 hy.1

/-- The actual diameter used by the default input scale: a supremum over all pairs. -/
def input_diameter (i : I) (D : Set X) : ENNReal :=
  ⨆ x ∈ D, ⨆ y ∈ D, d i x y

/-- Each pair in the evaluated domain is bounded by its actual diameter. -/
theorem component_distance_le_input_diameter (i : I) (D : Set X)
    (x y : X) (hx : x ∈ D) (hy : y ∈ D) :
    d i x y ≤ input_diameter d i D :=
  le_iSup_of_le x (le_iSup_of_le hx (le_iSup_of_le y (le_iSup_of_le hy le_rfl)))

/-- OET anchor: h-83287e414000b50b
默认直径尺度，由任意域上全部点对距离的上确界给出。 -/
noncomputable def diameter_scale_family : ScaleFamily X I where
  val := input_diameter d
  monotone := by
    intro i A B _hA _hB hAB
    apply iSup_le
    intro x
    apply iSup_le
    intro hx
    apply iSup_le
    intro y
    apply iSup_le
    intro hy
    exact component_distance_le_input_diameter d i B x y (hAB hx) (hAB hy)

/-- An output component constant on the evaluated domain has infinite
uniform zeroing radius for every input component. -/
theorem zero_radius_eq_top_of_output_zero
    (φ : Operator X bot) (A : Set X) (j : I)
    (hzero : ∀ x ∈ A,
      ∀ y ∈ A,
        d j (φ.func x)
          (φ.func y) = 0)
    (k : I) : min_annihilation_radius d φ k (singleton_nonempty_finset j) A = ⊤ := by
  apply top_unique
  apply le_iInf
  intro y
  apply le_iInf
  intro hy
  rw [← ENNReal.iSup_natCast]
  apply iSup_le
  intro n
  cases n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n =>
      have hr : FinitePositiveRadius ((Nat.succ n : ℕ) : ENNReal) :=
        ⟨by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_pos n, ENNReal.natCast_ne_top _⟩
      apply le_iSup_of_le ((Nat.succ n : ℕ) : ENNReal)
      apply le_iSup_of_le hr
      have hfib : OpenBall d k y (Nat.succ n) ∩ A ⊆
          ComputationalFiber d φ (singleton_nonempty_finset j) A (φ.func y) := by
        intro x hx
        refine ⟨hx.2, ?_⟩
        rw [comp_pseudo_metric_singleton]
        exact hzero x hx.2 y hy
      exact le_iSup_of_le hfib le_rfl

/-- OET anchor: h-610f439b6ff59f79
小输入域上的整体零化判据. When the actual diameter is below the ordered
thresholds, the zeroing test is equivalent to zero distance of every output pair.
The implication needs no extra finiteness assumptions beyond these inequalities. -/
theorem joint_zeroing_iff
    (φ : Operator X bot) (A : Set X) (i j : I) (τ_σ τ_ν : ENNReal)
    (hdiam : input_diameter d i A < τ_σ)
    (hthreshold : τ_σ ≤ τ_ν) :
    τ_ν ≤ min_annihilation_radius d φ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) A ↔
      ∀ x ∈ A,
        ∀ y ∈ A,
          d j (φ.func x)
            (φ.func y) = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro hν x hx y hy
    apply zero_of_lt_min_annihilation_radius d φ A i j y x τ_ν hν hy hx
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (component_distance_le_input_diameter d i _ x y hx hy)
      (lt_of_lt_of_le hdiam hthreshold)
  · intro hzero
    rw [zero_radius_eq_top_of_output_zero d φ A j hzero i]
    exact le_top

/-- The joint zeroing condition forces every radius
into the same output component to be infinite. -/
theorem joint_zeroing_all_radii_top
    (φ : Operator X bot) (A : Set X) (i j : I) (τ_σ τ_ν : ENNReal)
    (hdiam : input_diameter d i A < τ_σ)
    (hthreshold : τ_σ ≤ τ_ν)
    (hν : τ_ν ≤ min_annihilation_radius d φ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) A) :
    ∀ k : I, min_annihilation_radius d φ k (singleton_nonempty_finset j) A = ⊤ :=
  zero_radius_eq_top_of_output_zero d φ A j
    ((joint_zeroing_iff d φ A i j τ_σ τ_ν hdiam hthreshold).mp hν)

end
end formal_oet.vol_01.ch_03_operator_local_degeneracy

import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds.matrix_composition
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds.path_algebra
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_03_operator_local_degeneracy.annihilation_matrix

namespace formal_oet.vol_01.ch_04_operator_chain_calculus

noncomputable section

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_03_operator_local_degeneracy
open Set


open scoped BigOperators

variable {X I : Type} {bot : X}

/--
OET anchor: h-92938f295a2b0333
**定义（恒等算子）**
-/
def id_operator : Operator X bot := ⟨id, rfl⟩

/--
OET anchor: h-92938f295a2b0333
**定义（代数因式分解）**
排除两个平凡恒等因子。
-/
def AlgebraicFactorization (ϕ : Operator X bot) : Prop :=
  ∃ ϕ₁ ϕ₂ : Operator X bot,
    ϕ₁ ≠ id_operator ∧ ϕ₂ ≠ id_operator ∧ OperatorChain [ϕ₂, ϕ₁] = ϕ

/-- 给定非平凡因子即给出代数因式分解。 -/
theorem algebraic_factorization_of_witness (ϕ ϕ₁ ϕ₂ : Operator X bot)
    (h₁ : ϕ₁ ≠ id_operator) (h₂ : ϕ₂ ≠ id_operator)
    (hcomp : OperatorChain [ϕ₂, ϕ₁] = ϕ) :
    AlgebraicFactorization ϕ := by
  exact ⟨ϕ₁, ϕ₂, h₁, h₂, hcomp⟩

/--
域限制算子：在 `U` 内等于原算子，在 `U` 外映到 `bot`。
-/
noncomputable def restrict_operator (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) : Operator X bot := by
  classical
  exact
    ⟨fun x => if x ∈ U then ϕ.func x else bot, by
      by_cases hbot : bot ∈ U
      · simp [hbot, ϕ.preserves_bot]
      · simp [hbot]⟩

theorem restrict_operator_apply_of_mem (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    {x : X} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    (restrict_operator ϕ U).func x = ϕ.func x := by
  classical
  simp [restrict_operator, hx]

theorem restrict_operator_apply_of_not_mem (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    {x : X} (hx : x ∉ U) :
    (restrict_operator ϕ U).func x = bot := by
  classical
  simp [restrict_operator, hx]

/-- 若 `U ⊆ dom ϕ`，则限制算子的定义域正好是 `U`。 -/
theorem dom_restrict_operator_eq (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (hU : U ⊆ dom ϕ) :
    dom (restrict_operator ϕ U) = U := by
  classical
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ U
  · constructor
    · intro _; exact hx
    · intro _hx
      dsimp [dom]
      rw [restrict_operator_apply_of_mem ϕ U hx]
      exact hU hx
  · constructor
    · intro hdom
      dsimp [dom] at hdom
      rw [restrict_operator_apply_of_not_mem ϕ U hx] at hdom
      exact False.elim (hdom rfl)
    · intro h
      exact False.elim (hx h)

/--
OET anchor: h-a63623c9504af642
**命题 #h-a63623c9504af642（域限制与复合的相容性）**
域限制与二步复合在给定像域限制下相容。
-/
theorem restrict_comp_eq (ϕ₁ ϕ₂ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) :
    restrict_operator (OperatorChain [ϕ₂, ϕ₁]) U =
      OperatorChain [restrict_operator ϕ₂ (ϕ₁.func '' U), restrict_operator ϕ₁ U] := by
  classical
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ U
  · rw [restrict_operator_apply_of_mem (OperatorChain [ϕ₂, ϕ₁]) U hx]
    dsimp [OperatorChain]
    rw [restrict_operator_apply_of_mem ϕ₁ U hx]
    have him : ϕ₁.func x ∈ ϕ₁.func '' U := Set.mem_image_of_mem ϕ₁.func hx
    rw [restrict_operator_apply_of_mem ϕ₂ (ϕ₁.func '' U) him]
  · rw [restrict_operator_apply_of_not_mem (OperatorChain [ϕ₂, ϕ₁]) U hx]
    dsimp [OperatorChain]
    rw [restrict_operator_apply_of_not_mem ϕ₁ U hx]
    by_cases hbot : bot ∈ ϕ₁.func '' U
    · rw [restrict_operator_apply_of_mem ϕ₂ (ϕ₁.func '' U) hbot, ϕ₂.preserves_bot]
    · rw [restrict_operator_apply_of_not_mem ϕ₂ (ϕ₁.func '' U) hbot]

/-- 局部等价：两个算子在 `U` 上逐点相等。 -/
def LocalEquivalent (ϕ ψ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ U, ϕ.func x = ψ.func x

/-- 局部等价等价于域限制算子相等。 -/
theorem local_equivalent_iff_restrict_eq (ϕ ψ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) :
    LocalEquivalent ϕ ψ U ↔ restrict_operator ϕ U = restrict_operator ψ U := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h
    ext x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ U
    · simp [restrict_operator, hx, h x hx]
    · simp [restrict_operator, hx]
  · intro h x hx
    have happ := congrArg Operator.func h
    have hpoint := congrFun happ x
    simpa [restrict_operator, hx] using hpoint

variable [Fintype I]
local instance instDecidableEqIDecompositionCore : DecidableEq I := Classical.decEq I
variable (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)

/--
OET anchor: h-3d5f909fa9f5d7da
**命题 #h-3d5f909fa9f5d7da(i)**
Lip 矩阵可从大域限制到小域。
-/
theorem lip_localization (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U V : Set X)
    (L : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hUV : U ⊆ V)
    (hL : IsLipMatrix d ϕ V L) :
    IsLipMatrix d ϕ U L := by
  exact restricted_lip_matrix_family_antitone d ϕ U V hUV hL

/--
OET anchor: h-3d5f909fa9f5d7da
**命题 #h-3d5f909fa9f5d7da(ii)**
co-Lip 矩阵可从大域限制到非空小域。
-/
theorem colip_localization (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U V : Set X)
    (K : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hU_ne : U.Nonempty)
    (hUV : U ⊆ V)
    (hK : IsCoLipMatrix d ϕ V K) :
    IsCoLipMatrix d ϕ U K := by
  exact restricted_colip_matrix_family_antitone d ϕ U V hU_ne hUV hK

/--
OET anchor: h-5846008cae9ea67d
**命题 #h-5846008cae9ea67d（分段合成的全域证书比较界，Lip 分块限制核心）**
分段算子的全域 Lip 矩阵限制到任一分块后，仍是该分块局域算子的 Lip 矩阵。
-/
theorem piecewise_lip_restricts_to_piece (ψ ϕm : Operator X bot) (U Um : Set X)
    (L : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hUmU : Um ⊆ U)
    (h_agree : LocalEquivalent ψ ϕm Um)
    (hL : IsLipMatrix d ψ U L) :
    IsLipMatrix d ϕm Um L := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    dsimp [dom]
    rw [← h_agree x hx]
    exact hL.1 (hUmU hx)
  · intro x hx y hy j
    rw [← h_agree x hx, ← h_agree y hy]
    exact hL.2 x (hUmU hx) y (hUmU hy) j

/--
OET anchor: h-5846008cae9ea67d
**命题 #h-5846008cae9ea67d（分段合成的全域证书比较界，co-Lip 分块限制核心）**
分段算子的全域 co-Lip 矩阵限制到任一非空分块后，仍是该分块局域算子的 co-Lip 矩阵。
-/
theorem piecewise_colip_restricts_to_piece (ψ ϕm : Operator X bot) (U Um : Set X)
    (K : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hUm_ne : Um.Nonempty)
    (hUmU : Um ⊆ U)
    (h_agree : LocalEquivalent ψ ϕm Um)
    (hK : IsCoLipMatrix d ψ U K) :
    IsCoLipMatrix d ϕm Um K := by
  refine ⟨hUm_ne, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    dsimp [dom]
    rw [← h_agree x hx]
    exact hK.2.1 (hUmU hx)
  · intro x hx y hy j
    rw [← h_agree x hx, ← h_agree y hy]
    exact hK.2.2 x (hUmU hx) y (hUmU hy) j

/--
OET anchor: h-5bedef30d593a0bc
**引理 #h-5bedef30d593a0bc(i)**
局部等价保持受限 Lip 矩阵族。
-/
theorem local_equiv_lip_matrix_iff (ϕ ψ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (L : I → I → ENNReal)
    (h_eq : LocalEquivalent ϕ ψ U) :
    IsLipMatrix d ϕ U L ↔ IsLipMatrix d ψ U L := by
  constructor
  · intro hL
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x hx
      dsimp [dom]
      rw [← h_eq x hx]
      exact hL.1 hx
    · intro x hx y hy j
      rw [← h_eq x hx, ← h_eq y hy]
      exact hL.2 x hx y hy j
  · intro hL
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x hx
      dsimp [dom]
      rw [h_eq x hx]
      exact hL.1 hx
    · intro x hx y hy j
      rw [h_eq x hx, h_eq y hy]
      exact hL.2 x hx y hy j

/--
OET anchor: h-5bedef30d593a0bc
**引理 #h-5bedef30d593a0bc(ii)**
局部等价保持受限 co-Lip 矩阵族。
-/
theorem local_equiv_colip_matrix_iff (ϕ ψ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (K : I → I → ENNReal)
    (h_eq : LocalEquivalent ϕ ψ U) :
    IsCoLipMatrix d ϕ U K ↔ IsCoLipMatrix d ψ U K := by
  constructor
  · intro hK
    refine ⟨hK.1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x hx
      dsimp [dom]
      rw [← h_eq x hx]
      exact hK.2.1 hx
    · intro x hx y hy j
      rw [← h_eq x hx, ← h_eq y hy]
      exact hK.2.2 x hx y hy j
  · intro hK
    refine ⟨hK.1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x hx
      dsimp [dom]
      rw [h_eq x hx]
      exact hK.2.1 hx
    · intro x hx y hy j
      rw [h_eq x hx, h_eq y hy]
      exact hK.2.2 x hx y hy j

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
set_option linter.unusedFintypeInType false in
/--
OET anchor: h-5bedef30d593a0bc
**引理 #h-5bedef30d593a0bc(iii) 的纤维核心**
局部等价使同一中心点诱导的计算纤维一致。
-/
theorem local_equiv_computational_fiber_eq (ϕ ψ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (J : NonemptyFinset I) (y : X)
    (h_eq : LocalEquivalent ϕ ψ U) (hy : y ∈ U) :
    ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U (ϕ.func y) =
      ComputationalFiber d ψ J U (ψ.func y) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx, hdist⟩
    refine ⟨hx, ?_⟩
    rwa [← h_eq x hx, ← h_eq y hy]
  · rintro ⟨hx, hdist⟩
    refine ⟨hx, ?_⟩
    rwa [h_eq x hx, h_eq y hy]

/-- A point with different outputs witnesses distinct operators. -/
theorem operator_ne_of_exists_point_ne (ϕ ψ : Operator X bot) (x₀ : X)
    (hneq : ϕ.func x₀ ≠ ψ.func x₀) :
    ϕ ≠ ψ := by
  intro h
  exact hneq (by rw [h])

/-- Replace one input value by `a` and leave every other point unchanged. -/
noncomputable def replace_at_operator (a b : X) (hb : b ≠ bot) : Operator X bot := by
  classical
  exact
    ⟨fun x => if x = b then a else x, by
      have hbotb : bot ≠ b := Ne.symm hb
      simp [hbotb]⟩

/--
OET anchor: h-11fd78baa402e538
**命题 #h-11fd78baa402e538（局部等价不蕴含全域等价）**
存在两个不同的非吸收点时，可构造定义域相同的两个算子，
使其在共同定义域的非空子集上局部等价，但并非同一算子。
-/
theorem local_equivalent_not_global_counterexample (a b : X)
    (ha : a ≠ bot) (hb : b ≠ bot) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    ∃ (ϕ ψ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X),
      dom ϕ = dom ψ ∧ U.Nonempty ∧ U ⊆ dom ϕ ∧
        LocalEquivalent ϕ ψ U ∧ ϕ ≠ ψ := by
  classical
  refine ⟨id_operator, replace_at_operator a b hb, {a}, ?_,
    Set.singleton_nonempty a, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext x
    by_cases hxb : x = b
    · subst x
      simp [dom, id_operator, replace_at_operator, ha, hb]
    · simp [dom, id_operator, replace_at_operator, hxb]
  · intro x hx
    have hxa : x = a := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hx
    subst x
    simpa [dom, id_operator] using ha
  · intro x hx
    have hxa : x = a := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hx
    subst x
    simp [id_operator, replace_at_operator, hab]
  · apply operator_ne_of_exists_point_ne (x₀ := b)
    simpa [id_operator, replace_at_operator] using Ne.symm hab

/--
OET anchor: h-a1caa879309ff2e3
**逐步局部等价的列表表示**
逐步局部等价数据。
列表顺序与 `OperatorChain` 一致：尾部先作用，表头后作用。
-/
inductive StepwiseLocalEquivalent :
    List (Operator X bot) → List (Operator X bot) → Set X → Prop
  | nil (U : Set X) : StepwiseLocalEquivalent [] [] U
  | cons {ϕ ψ : Operator X bot} {ϕs ψs : List (Operator X bot)} {U : Set X}
      (h_tail : StepwiseLocalEquivalent ϕs ψs U)
      (h_head : LocalEquivalent ϕ ψ ((OperatorChain ϕs).func '' U)) :
      StepwiseLocalEquivalent (ϕ :: ϕs) (ψ :: ψs) U

/--
OET anchor: h-95e7f90e21e41cae
**命题 #h-95e7f90e21e41cae(ii)**
逐步局部等价推出复合算子在初始域上局部等价。
-/
theorem stepwise_local_equiv_operator_chain :
    ∀ {ϕs ψs : List (Operator X bot)} {U : Set X},
      StepwiseLocalEquivalent ϕs ψs U →
        LocalEquivalent (OperatorChain ϕs) (OperatorChain ψs) U
  | [], [], U, StepwiseLocalEquivalent.nil _ => by
      intro x hx
      rfl
  | ϕ :: ϕs, ψ :: ψs, U, StepwiseLocalEquivalent.cons h_tail h_head => by
      intro x hx
      have h_tail_eq := stepwise_local_equiv_operator_chain h_tail x hx
      have h_head_eq :=
        h_head ((OperatorChain ϕs).func x) (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hx)
      dsimp [OperatorChain]
      rw [← h_tail_eq]
      exact h_head_eq

/-- Internal predicate for an operator synthesized on a restricted domain. -/
def DomainSynthesis (ψ ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) : Prop :=
  LocalEquivalent ψ ϕ U ∧ dom ψ = U ∧ U ⊆ dom ϕ

/-- Equality criterion for the internal domain-synthesis predicate. -/
theorem domain_synthesis_eq_iff (ψ ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (h_syn : DomainSynthesis ψ ϕ U) :
    ψ = ϕ ↔ U = dom ϕ := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← h_syn.2.1, h]
  · intro hU
    ext x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ U
    · exact h_syn.1 x hx
    · have hψ_not_dom : x ∉ dom ψ := by
        rw [h_syn.2.1]
        exact hx
      have hϕ_not_dom : x ∉ dom ϕ := by
        rw [← hU]
        exact hx
      have hψ_bot : ψ.func x = bot := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hψ_not_dom hne
      have hϕ_bot : ϕ.func x = bot := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hϕ_not_dom hne
      rw [hψ_bot, hϕ_bot]

end

end formal_oet.vol_01.ch_04_operator_chain_calculus

import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks.network_presentation
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks.network_routing

namespace formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_04_operator_chain_calculus
open FiniteOperatorNetwork
noncomputable section
variable {X V : Type} {bot : X}

/-- Exactly the local factor data allowed by algebraic refinement. -/
structure NodeFactorizationData (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V) (target : V) where
  first : Operator X bot
  second : Operator X bot
  first_domain : N.node_dom target ⊆ dom first
  second_domain : first.func '' N.node_dom target ⊆ dom second
  factorization : ∀ x ∈ N.node_dom target,
    (N.node_op target).func x = second.func (first.func x)

namespace NodeFactorizationData
variable {N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V} {target : V}
variable (F : NodeFactorizationData N target)
local instance : DecidableEq V := Classical.decEq V

/-- The target's old label becomes the first factor; the extra label is the second. -/
def node_op : V ⊕ Unit → Operator X bot := by
  classical
  exact fun v => match v with
    | .inl v => if v = target then restrict_operator F.first (N.node_dom target) else N.node_op v
    | .inr _ => restrict_operator F.second (F.first.func '' N.node_dom target)

def choice (_F : NodeFactorizationData N target) : (V ⊕ Unit) → X → OutputChoice (V ⊕ Unit) := by
  classical
  exact fun v z => match v with
    | .inl v => if v = target then .next (.inr ()) else
        map_output_choice Sum.inl (N.choice v z)
    | .inr _ => map_output_choice Sum.inl (N.choice target z)

/--
OET anchor: h-eddd1f2d0a9d3528
An old self-loop returns from the second factor to the first, with its old domain.
-/
theorem self_loop_choice_iff (z : X) :
    F.choice (.inr ()) z = .next (.inl target) ↔
      N.choice target z = .next target := by
  cases h : N.choice target z <;> simp [choice, map_output_choice, h]

@[simp] theorem node_dom_inl (v : V) : dom (F.node_op (.inl v)) = N.node_dom v := by
  classical
  by_cases hv : v = target
  · subst v
    simp only [node_op, ↓reduceIte]
    exact dom_restrict_operator_eq F.first _ F.first_domain
  · simp [node_op, hv, node_dom_eq_dom]

@[simp] theorem node_dom_inr : dom (F.node_op (.inr ())) =
    F.first.func '' N.node_dom target :=
  dom_restrict_operator_eq F.second _ F.second_domain

theorem first_apply (x : X) (hx : x ∈ N.node_dom target) :
    (F.node_op (.inl target)).func x = F.first.func x := by
  classical
  simp only [node_op, ↓reduceIte]
  exact restrict_operator_apply_of_mem _ _ hx

theorem pair_apply (x : X) (hx : x ∈ N.node_dom target) :
    (F.node_op (.inr ())).func ((F.node_op (.inl target)).func x) =
      (N.node_op target).func x := by
  rw [F.first_apply x hx]
  change (restrict_operator F.second _).func _ = _
  rw [restrict_operator_apply_of_mem F.second (F.first.func '' N.node_dom target)
    (show F.first.func x ∈ F.first.func '' N.node_dom target from ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)]
  exact (F.factorization x hx).symm

theorem choice_next_mem {v w : V ⊕ Unit} {x : X}
    (hx : x ∈ dom (F.node_op v))
    (hc : F.choice v ((F.node_op v).func x) = .next w) :
    (F.node_op v).func x ∈ dom (F.node_op w) := by
  classical
  cases v with
  | inl v =>
    by_cases hv : v = target
    · subst v
      simp only [choice, ↓reduceIte, OutputChoice.next.injEq] at hc
      subst w
      rw [F.node_dom_inl] at hx
      rw [F.node_dom_inr, F.first_apply x hx]
      exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    · simp only [choice, hv, if_false, map_output_choice] at hc
      split at hc
      · contradiction
      · rename_i u hu
        cases hc
        rw [F.node_dom_inl]
        have hxold : x ∈ N.node_dom v := (F.node_dom_inl v) ▸ hx
        have hop : F.node_op (.inl v) = N.node_op v := by simp [node_op, hv]
        rw [hop] at hu ⊢
        exact N.choice_next_mem hxold hu
  | inr u =>
    cases u
    rw [F.node_dom_inr] at hx
    rcases hx with ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    have hout : (F.node_op (.inr ())).func (F.first.func y) =
        (N.node_op target).func y := by
      simpa only [F.first_apply y hy] using F.pair_apply y hy
    simp only [choice, map_output_choice] at hc
    split at hc
    · contradiction
    · rename_i w hw
      cases hc
      rw [F.node_dom_inl, hout]
      rw [hout] at hw
      exact N.choice_next_mem hy hw

def expand_path (F : NodeFactorizationData N target) : List V → List (V ⊕ Unit)
  | [] => []
  | v :: rest => if v = target then .inl v :: .inr () :: F.expand_path rest
      else .inl v :: F.expand_path rest

theorem expand_path_length (p : List V) : (F.expand_path p).length ≤ 2 * p.length := by
  classical
  induction p with
  | nil => simp [expand_path]
  | cons v rest ih =>
    by_cases hv : v = target <;> simp only [expand_path, hv, if_true, if_false, List.length_cons]
    all_goals omega

theorem expanded_terminal {v x p}
    (ht : TerminalPathFrom N.node_op N.choice v x p) (hx : x ∈ N.node_dom v) :
    TerminalPathFrom F.node_op F.choice (.inl v) x (F.expand_path p) := by
  classical
  induction ht with
  | @stop v x hs =>
    by_cases hv : v = target
    · subst v
      simp only [expand_path, ↓reduceIte]
      apply TerminalPathFrom.next (γ := .inr ()) (by simp [choice])
      apply TerminalPathFrom.stop
      simp [choice, F.pair_apply x hx, hs, map_output_choice]
    · simp only [expand_path, if_neg hv]
      apply TerminalPathFrom.stop
      simp [choice, node_op, hv, hs, map_output_choice]
  | @next v w x rest hs ht ih =>
    have hy := N.choice_next_mem hx hs
    by_cases hv : v = target
    · subst v
      simp only [expand_path, ↓reduceIte]
      apply TerminalPathFrom.next (γ := .inr ()) (by simp [choice])
      apply TerminalPathFrom.next (γ := .inl w)
      · simp [choice, F.pair_apply x hx, hs, map_output_choice]
      · rw [F.pair_apply x hx]
        exact ih hy
    · simp only [expand_path, if_neg hv]
      apply TerminalPathFrom.next (γ := .inl w)
      · simp [choice, node_op, hv, hs, map_output_choice]
      · simpa [node_op, hv] using ih hy

theorem expanded_eval {v x p}
    (ht : TerminalPathFrom N.node_op N.choice v x p) (hx : x ∈ N.node_dom v) :
    chain_eval_nodes_core F.node_op (F.expand_path p) x =
      chain_eval_nodes_core N.node_op p x := by
  classical
  induction ht with
  | @stop v x hs =>
    by_cases hv : v = target
    · subst v
      simpa only [expand_path, ↓reduceIte, chain_eval_nodes_core] using F.pair_apply x hx
    · simp [expand_path, hv, chain_eval_nodes_core, node_op]
  | @next v w x rest hs ht ih =>
    have hy := N.choice_next_mem hx hs
    by_cases hv : v = target
    · subst v
      simp only [expand_path, ↓reduceIte, chain_eval_nodes_core]
      rw [F.pair_apply x hx]
      exact ih hy
    · simpa [expand_path, hv, chain_eval_nodes_core, node_op] using ih hy

/-- Build all finite-network obligations, prior to reachability pruning. -/
def presentation : FiniteNetworkPresentation X bot (V ⊕ Unit) := by
  classical
  letI := N.node_fintype
  exact {
    U := N.U
    bot_not_mem := N.bot_not_mem
    node_fintype := inferInstance
    node_op := F.node_op
    node_dom_nonempty := by
      intro v
      cases v with
      | inl v => simpa using N.node_dom_nonempty v
      | inr u =>
        cases u
        rw [F.node_dom_inr]
        exact (N.node_dom_nonempty target).image F.first.func
    entry := fun x => .inl (N.entry x)
    entry_mem := by intro x; rw [F.node_dom_inl]; exact N.entry_mem x
    choice := F.choice
    choice_next_mem := F.choice_next_mem
    depth_bound := 2 * N.depth_bound
    path_of := fun x => F.expand_path (N.path_of x)
    path_terminal := fun x => F.expanded_terminal (N.path_terminal x) (N.entry_mem x)
    path_length_le_depth := fun x => (F.expand_path_length _).trans
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (N.path_length_le_depth x))
  }

/--
OET anchor: h-eddd1f2d0a9d3528
Actual algebraic refinement from the two factors in the definition.
-/
def network := F.presentation.prune

/--
OET anchor: h-012f4ba72aeb3f20
The constructed network replaces every target occurrence by two consecutive nodes.
-/
theorem network_path_labels (x : N.U) :
    (F.network.path_of x).map Subtype.val = F.expand_path (N.path_of x) :=
  F.presentation.prune_path_labels x

/--
OET anchor: h-012f4ba72aeb3f20
The actual constructed and pruned algebraic refinement has the same global operator.
-/
theorem network_extensional_eq : F.network.extensional_operator = N.extensional_operator := by
  classical
  apply Operator.ext
  funext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ N.U
  · change (if h : x ∈ N.U then F.network.eval ⟨x, h⟩ else bot) = _
    rw [dif_pos hx]
    change F.presentation.prune.eval ⟨x, hx⟩ = _
    rw [FiniteNetworkPresentation.prune_eval]
    exact (F.expanded_eval (N.path_terminal ⟨x, hx⟩) (N.entry_mem _)).trans
      (N.extensional_apply_eq_chain_eval_path ⟨x, hx⟩).symm
  · simp [extensional_operator, network, presentation, FiniteNetworkPresentation.prune, hx]

end NodeFactorizationData
end
end formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks
