files.content:
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks.network_presentation
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks.network_refinement

namespace formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_04_operator_chain_calculus
open FiniteOperatorNetwork
noncomputable section
variable {X V : Type} {bot : X}

/-- The finite partition and local operators in the node-domain refinement definition. -/
structure NodePartitionData (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V) (target : V) where
  count : ℕ
  count_pos : 0 < count
  piece : Fin count → Set X
  nonempty : ∀ a, (piece a).Nonempty
  disjoint : ∀ {a b}, a ≠ b → Disjoint (piece a) (piece b)
  cover : (⋃ a, piece a) = N.node_dom target
  local_op : Fin count → Operator X bot
  local_domain : ∀ a, dom (local_op a) = piece a
  local_eq : ∀ a x, x ∈ piece a → (local_op a).func x = (N.node_op target).func x

namespace NodePartitionData
variable {N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V} {target : V}
variable (P : NodePartitionData N target)

/--
OET anchor: h-eddd1f2d0a9d3528
The prescribed domain and local equality determine the whole subnode operator.
-/
theorem local_op_eq_restrict (a : Fin P.count) :
    P.local_op a = restrict_operator (N.node_op target) (P.piece a) := by
  apply Operator.ext
  funext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ P.piece a
  · rw [restrict_operator_apply_of_mem _ _ hx]
    exact P.local_eq a x hx
  · rw [restrict_operator_apply_of_not_mem _ _ hx]
    by_contra hne
    exact hx ((P.local_domain a) ▸ hne)

abbrev Label := {v : V // v ≠ target} ⊕ Fin P.count

/-- On the target domain the unique partition member is chosen. Outside it the
choice is an irrelevant totalization used only to define the routing function. -/
def piece_at (x : X) : Fin P.count := by
  classical
  exact if h : ∃ a, x ∈ P.piece a then h.choose else ⟨0, P.count_pos⟩

theorem mem_piece_at (x : X) (hx : x ∈ N.node_dom target) : x ∈ P.piece (P.piece_at x) := by
  classical
  have h : ∃ a, x ∈ P.piece a := by rw [← P.cover] at hx; exact Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
  simpa [piece_at, h] using h.choose_spec

theorem piece_at_unique (x : X) (a : Fin P.count) (hx : x ∈ P.piece a) : P.piece_at x = a := by
  have hxdom : x ∈ N.node_dom target := by rw [← P.cover]; exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨a, hx⟩
  by_contra h
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (P.disjoint h) (P.mem_piece_at x hxdom) hx

def projection : P.Label → V
  | .inl v => v.val
  | .inr _ => target

def lift_label (v : V) (x : X) : P.Label := by
  classical
  exact if hv : v = target then .inr (P.piece_at x) else .inl ⟨v, hv⟩

@[simp] theorem projection_lift (v : V) (x : X) : P.projection (P.lift_label v x) = v := by
  classical
  by_cases hv : v = target <;> simp [lift_label, projection, hv]

def node_op : P.Label → Operator X bot
  | .inl v => N.node_op v.val
  | .inr a => P.local_op a

theorem lift_mem_dom (v : V) (x : X) (hx : x ∈ N.node_dom v) :
    x ∈ dom (P.node_op (P.lift_label v x)) := by
  classical
  by_cases hv : v = target
  · subst v
    simp only [lift_label, ↓reduceDIte, node_op, P.local_domain]
    exact P.mem_piece_at x hx
  · simpa [lift_label, hv, node_op] using hx

theorem lift_apply (v : V) (x : X) (hx : x ∈ N.node_dom v) :
    (P.node_op (P.lift_label v x)).func x = (N.node_op v).func x := by
  classical
  by_cases hv : v = target
  · subst v
    simp only [lift_label, ↓reduceDIte, node_op]
    exact P.local_eq _ x (P.mem_piece_at x hx)
  · simp [lift_label, hv, node_op]

theorem node_domain_subset_original (v : P.Label) :
    dom (P.node_op v) ⊆ N.node_dom (P.projection v) := by
  cases v with
  | inl v => exact Set.Subset.rfl
  | inr a =>
    intro x hx
    rw [node_op, P.local_domain a] at hx
    change x ∈ N.node_dom target
    rw [← P.cover]
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨a, hx⟩

theorem node_apply_eq_original (v : P.Label) (x : X) (hx : x ∈ dom (P.node_op v)) :
    (P.node_op v).func x = (N.node_op (P.projection v)).func x := by
  cases v with
  | inl v => rfl
  | inr a => exact P.local_eq a x ((P.local_domain a) ▸ hx)

def choice (v : P.Label) (z : X) : OutputChoice P.Label :=
  map_output_choice (fun w => P.lift_label w z) (N.choice (P.projection v) z)

/--
OET anchor: h-eddd1f2d0a9d3528
A split self-loop must select both the source piece and the destination piece.
This is the routing part of the double-intersection edge formula.
-/
theorem self_loop_choice_iff (a b : Fin P.count) (z : X)
    (hz : z ∈ (P.local_op a).func '' P.piece a) :
    P.choice (.inr a) z = .next (.inr b) ↔
      z ∈ N.edge_domain target target ∧ z ∈ P.piece b := by
  classical
  have himage : z ∈ N.node_image target := by
    rcases hz with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨x, ?_, (P.local_eq a x hx).symm⟩
    change x ∈ N.node_dom target
    rw [← P.cover]
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨a, hx⟩
  constructor
  · intro h
    unfold choice map_output_choice at h
    split at h
    · contradiction
    · rename_i v hv
      have hlift : P.lift_label v z = .inr b := OutputChoice.next.inj h
      have hvtarget : v = target := by
        have hproj := congrArg P.projection hlift
        change P.projection (P.lift_label v z) = target at hproj
        rw [P.projection_lift] at hproj
        exact hproj
      subst v
      have hpiece : P.piece_at z = b := by
        simpa [lift_label] using hlift
      have hedge : z ∈ N.edge_domain target target := ⟨himage, hv⟩
      refine ⟨hedge, ?_⟩
      rw [← hpiece]
      exact P.mem_piece_at z (N.edge_domain_subset_node_dom hedge)
  · rintro ⟨hedge, hpiece⟩
    have hchoice : N.choice target z = .next target := hedge.2
    simp [choice, projection, map_output_choice, hchoice, lift_label,
      P.piece_at_unique z b hpiece]

theorem choice_next_mem {v w : P.Label} {x : X}
    (hx : x ∈ dom (P.node_op v)) (hc : P.choice v ((P.node_op v).func x) = .next w) :
    (P.node_op v).func x ∈ dom (P.node_op w) := by
  unfold choice map_output_choice at hc
  split at hc
  · contradiction
  · rename_i u hu
    cases hc
    apply P.lift_mem_dom
    have hdom := P.node_domain_subset_original v hx
    rw [P.node_apply_eq_original v x hx] at hu ⊢
    exact N.choice_next_mem hdom hu

/-- Recolour each target occurrence using its actual current input. -/
def colour_path (P : NodePartitionData N target) : List V → X → List P.Label
  | [], _ => []
  | v :: rest, x => P.lift_label v x :: P.colour_path rest ((N.node_op v).func x)

@[simp] theorem colour_path_length (p : List V) (x : X) :
    (P.colour_path p x).length = p.length := by
  induction p generalizing x with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons v rest ih => simp [colour_path, ih]

@[simp] theorem colour_path_projection (p : List V) (x : X) :
    (P.colour_path p x).map P.projection = p := by
  induction p generalizing x with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons v rest ih => simp [colour_path, ih]

theorem coloured_terminal {v x p}
    (ht : TerminalPathFrom N.node_op N.choice v x p) (hx : x ∈ N.node_dom v) :
    TerminalPathFrom P.node_op P.choice (P.lift_label v x) x (P.colour_path p x) := by
  induction ht with
  | @stop v x hs =>
    apply TerminalPathFrom.stop
    simp [choice, P.lift_apply v x hx, hs, map_output_choice]
  | @next v w x rest hs ht ih =>
    apply TerminalPathFrom.next (γ := P.lift_label w ((N.node_op v).func x))
    · simp [choice, P.lift_apply v x hx, hs, map_output_choice]
    · rw [P.lift_apply v x hx]
      exact ih (N.choice_next_mem hx hs)

theorem coloured_eval {v x p}
    (ht : TerminalPathFrom N.node_op N.choice v x p) (hx : x ∈ N.node_dom v) :
    chain_eval_nodes_core P.node_op (P.colour_path p x) x =
      chain_eval_nodes_core N.node_op p x := by
  induction ht with
  | @stop v x hs => simp [colour_path, chain_eval_nodes_core, P.lift_apply v x hx]
  | @next v w x rest hs ht ih =>
    simp only [colour_path, chain_eval_nodes_core, P.lift_apply v x hx]
    exact ih (N.choice_next_mem hx hs)

/-- Every finite-network obligation is derived before unreachable-piece deletion. -/
def presentation : FiniteNetworkPresentation X bot P.Label := by
  classical
  letI := N.node_fintype
  exact {
    U := N.U
    bot_not_mem := N.bot_not_mem
    node_fintype := inferInstance
    node_op := P.node_op
    node_dom_nonempty := by
      intro v
      cases v with
      | inl v => exact N.node_dom_nonempty v.val
      | inr a => simpa only [node_op, P.local_domain] using P.nonempty a
    entry := fun x => P.lift_label (N.entry x) x.val
    entry_mem := fun x => P.lift_mem_dom (N.entry x) x.val (N.entry_mem x)
    choice := P.choice
    choice_next_mem := P.choice_next_mem
    depth_bound := N.depth_bound
    path_of := fun x => P.colour_path (N.path_of x) x.val
    path_terminal := fun x => P.coloured_terminal (N.path_terminal x) (N.entry_mem x)
    path_length_le_depth := by intro x; simpa using N.path_length_le_depth x
  }

/--
OET anchor: h-eddd1f2d0a9d3528
Actual node-domain refinement, including deletion of all unreachable pieces.
-/
def network := P.presentation.prune

/--
OET anchor: h-012f4ba72aeb3f20
The constructed refinement has exactly the recoloured original paths.
-/
theorem network_path_labels (x : N.U) :
    (P.network.path_of x).map Subtype.val = P.colour_path (N.path_of x) x.val :=
  P.presentation.prune_path_labels x

/--
OET anchor: h-012f4ba72aeb3f20
Forgetting split labels recovers the actual original path, so its length is unchanged.
-/
theorem network_path_projection (x : N.U) :
    (P.network.path_of x).map (fun v => P.projection v.val) = N.path_of x := by
  change List.map (P.projection ∘ Subtype.val) (P.network.path_of x) = _
  rw [← List.map_map, P.network_path_labels, P.colour_path_projection]

/--
OET anchor: h-012f4ba72aeb3f20
The actual constructed and pruned domain refinement has the same global operator.
-/
theorem network_extensional_eq : P.network.extensional_operator = N.extensional_operator := by
  classical
  apply Operator.ext
  funext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ N.U
  · change (if h : x ∈ N.U then P.network.eval ⟨x, h⟩ else bot) = _
    rw [dif_pos hx]
    change P.presentation.prune.eval ⟨x, hx⟩ = _
    rw [FiniteNetworkPresentation.prune_eval]
    exact (P.coloured_eval (N.path_terminal ⟨x, hx⟩) (N.entry_mem _)).trans
      (N.extensional_apply_eq_chain_eval_path ⟨x, hx⟩).symm
  · simp [extensional_operator, network, presentation, FiniteNetworkPresentation.prune, hx]

/-- The recoloured occurrence uses the original current input at that position. -/
theorem colour_path_get (p : List V) (x : X) (n : Fin p.length) :
    (P.colour_path p x).get ⟨n.val, by simp [n.isLt]⟩ =
      P.lift_label (p.get n) (N.chain_eval_nodes (p.take n.val) x) := by
  induction p generalizing x with
  | nil => exact Fin.elim0 n
  | cons v rest ih =>
    rcases n with ⟨n, hn⟩
    cases n with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n =>
      simpa [colour_path, FiniteOperatorNetwork.chain_eval_nodes,
        chain_eval_nodes_core] using ih ((N.node_op v).func x) ⟨n, by simpa using hn⟩

/-- A local input uniquely identifies its full split label. -/
theorem lift_projection_of_mem (v : P.Label) (x : X) (hx : x ∈ dom (P.node_op v)) :
    P.lift_label (P.projection v) x = v := by
  classical
  cases v with
  | inl v => simp [projection, lift_label, v.property]
  | inr a =>
    have ha : x ∈ P.piece a := (P.local_domain a) ▸ hx
    simp [projection, lift_label, P.piece_at_unique x a ha]

/-- Every unaffected old node is retained after refinement. -/
theorem old_label_reached (v : {v : V // v ≠ target}) :
    P.presentation.Reached (.inl v) := by
  rcases N.node_reachable v.val with ⟨x, hx⟩
  have hm : v.val ∈ (P.colour_path (N.path_of x) x.val).map P.projection := by
    rw [P.colour_path_projection]
    exact hx
  rcases List.mem_map.mp hm with ⟨w, hw, hp⟩
  have hwv : w = .inl v := by
    cases w with
    | inl u => exact congrArg Sum.inl (Subtype.ext hp)
    | inr a => exact False.elim (v.property hp.symm)
  exact ⟨x, hwv ▸ hw⟩

/-- A split piece survives exactly when an original occurrence enters it. -/
theorem piece_label_reached_iff (a : Fin P.count) :
    P.presentation.Reached (.inr a) ↔ NodePieceReached N target P.piece a := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := List.get_of_mem hx
    have hlen : n.val < (N.path_of x).length := by
      simpa only [presentation, colour_path_length] using n.isLt
    let k : Fin (N.path_of x).length := ⟨n.val, hlen⟩
    have hget : P.lift_label ((N.path_of x).get k)
        (N.chain_eval_nodes ((N.path_of x).take k.val) x.val) = .inr a := by
      exact (P.colour_path_get (N.path_of x) x.val k).symm.trans hn
    have htarget : (N.path_of x).get k = target := by
      have hp := congrArg P.projection hget
      change P.projection (P.lift_label ((N.path_of x).get k)
        (N.chain_eval_nodes ((N.path_of x).take k.val) x.val)) = target at hp
      rwa [P.projection_lift] at hp
    have hdom : N.chain_eval_nodes ((N.path_of x).take k.val) x.val ∈
        N.node_dom ((N.path_of x).get k) :=
      terminal_path_prefix_input_mem N.choice_next_mem (N.entry_mem x) (N.path_terminal x) k
    refine ⟨x, k, htarget, ?_⟩
    have hlocal := P.lift_mem_dom ((N.path_of x).get k) _ hdom
    rw [hget] at hlocal
    exact (P.local_domain a) ▸ hlocal
  · rintro ⟨x, n, hn, hp⟩
    refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
    have hget := P.colour_path_get (N.path_of x) x.val n
    rw [hn] at hget
    have hlift : P.lift_label target
        (N.chain_eval_nodes ((N.path_of x).take n.val) x.val) = .inr a := by
      classical
      simp [lift_label, P.piece_at_unique _ a hp]
    rw [hlift] at hget
    exact hget ▸ List.get_mem _ _

/-- On complete local images, refinement has precisely the textbook edge
intersection formula. Unreachable destinations have already been removed. -/
theorem network_edge_domain_eq (v w : {v // P.presentation.Reached v}) :
    P.network.edge_domain v w =
      (N.edge_domain (P.projection v.val) (P.projection w.val) ∩
        P.network.node_image v) ∩ P.network.node_dom w := by
  classical
  ext z
  change (z ∈ P.network.node_image v ∧
    prune_choice P.presentation.Reached P.choice v z = .next w) ↔ _
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hz, hc⟩
    have hchoice : P.choice v.val z = .next w.val := by
      unfold prune_choice at hc
      split at hc
      · contradiction
      · rename_i u hu
        split at hc
        · cases hc
          exact hu
        · contradiction
    have hproj : N.choice (P.projection v.val) z = .next (P.projection w.val) := by
      unfold choice map_output_choice at hchoice
      split at hchoice
      · contradiction
      · rename_i u hu
        have heq := congrArg P.projection (OutputChoice.next.inj hchoice)
        rw [P.projection_lift] at heq
        exact heq ▸ hu
    have himage : z ∈ N.node_image (P.projection v.val) := by
      rcases hz with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨x, P.node_domain_subset_original v.val hx,
        (P.node_apply_eq_original v.val x hx).symm⟩
    have hw := P.network.edge_domain_subset_node_dom
      (show z ∈ P.network.edge_domain v w from ⟨hz, hc⟩)
    exact ⟨⟨⟨himage, hproj⟩, hz⟩, hw⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨hz, hv⟩, hw⟩
    refine ⟨hv, ?_⟩
    have hchoice : P.choice v.val z = .next w.val := by
      rw [choice, hz.2, map_output_choice, P.lift_projection_of_mem w.val z hw]
    simp [prune_choice, hchoice, w.property]

/-- Pruning keeps the route at every actually encountered local output. -/
theorem network_choice_projection (v : {v // P.presentation.Reached v}) (z : X)
    (hz : z ∈ (P.network.node_op v).func '' P.network.node_actual_input_domain v) :
    map_output_choice (fun w => P.projection w.val) (P.network.choice v z) =
      N.choice (P.projection v.val) z := by
  classical
  rcases hz with ⟨y, ⟨x, pref, suffix, hpath, hy, hydom⟩, rfl⟩
  have heval : ∀ (p : List {v // P.presentation.Reached v}) (x : X),
      chain_eval_nodes_core P.node_op (p.map Subtype.val) x = P.network.chain_eval_nodes p x := by
    intro p x
    induction p generalizing x with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons v rest ih => exact ih _
  have hpath' : P.presentation.path_of x =
      pref.map Subtype.val ++ v.val :: suffix.map Subtype.val := by
    change P.colour_path (N.path_of x) x.val = _
    rw [← P.network_path_labels x, hpath]
    simp
  have hp : ∀ u, P.choice v.val ((P.node_op v.val).func y) = .next u →
      P.presentation.Reached u := by
    intro u hu
    have hu' : P.choice v.val
        ((P.node_op v.val).func (chain_eval_nodes_core P.node_op (pref.map Subtype.val) x.val)) =
          .next u := by
      rw [heval, ← hy]
      exact hu
    obtain ⟨tail, htail⟩ := terminal_path_suffix_of_next_at_prefix
      (P.presentation.path_terminal x) hpath' hu'
    refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
    rw [hpath', htail]
    simp
  change map_output_choice (fun w => P.projection w.val)
    (prune_choice P.presentation.Reached P.choice v ((P.node_op v.val).func y)) =
      N.choice (P.projection v.val) ((P.node_op v.val).func y)
  cases hc : P.choice v.val ((P.node_op v.val).func y) with
  | stop =>
    have ho : N.choice (P.projection v.val) ((P.node_op v.val).func y) = .stop := by
      unfold choice map_output_choice at hc
      split at hc
      · assumption
      · contradiction
    simp [prune_choice, hc, map_output_choice, ho]
  | next u =>
    have ho : N.choice (P.projection v.val) ((P.node_op v.val).func y) =
        .next (P.projection u) := by
      unfold choice map_output_choice at hc
      split at hc
      · contradiction
      · rename_i w hw
        have heq := congrArg P.projection (OutputChoice.next.inj hc)
        rw [P.projection_lift] at heq
        exact heq ▸ hw
    simp [prune_choice, hc, hp u hc, map_output_choice, ho]

theorem network_label_projection (v : {v // P.presentation.Reached v}) :
    node_domain_projection target Subtype.val v = P.projection v.val := by
  cases hv : v.val <;> simp only [node_domain_projection, projection, hv]

/--
OET anchor: h-eddd1f2d0a9d3528
The exact constructive refinement inhabits the textbook relation, including
nonredundancy, entry data, all unused retained edges and split self-loops.
-/
def network_refinement : NodeDomainRefinement N P.network where
  target := target
  part_count := P.count
  part_count_pos := P.count_pos
  piece := P.piece
  piece_nonempty := P.nonempty
  piece_disjoint := P.disjoint
  piece_cover := P.cover
  local_factor := P.local_op
  local_domain := P.local_domain
  local_equiv := P.local_eq
  source := Subtype.val
  source_injective := Subtype.val_injective
  old_node_present := fun v => ⟨⟨.inl v, P.old_label_reached v⟩, rfl⟩
  piece_node_present_iff_reached := by
    intro a
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
      exact (P.piece_label_reached_iff a).mp (hv ▸ v.property)
    · intro h
      exact ⟨⟨.inr a, (P.piece_label_reached_iff a).mpr h⟩, rfl⟩
  old_node_op_compat := by
    intro v w h
    change P.node_op v.val = N.node_op w.val
    rw [h]
    rfl
  piece_node_op_compat := by
    intro v a h
    change P.node_op v.val = P.local_op a
    rw [h]
    rfl
  same_input_domain := rfl
  entry_projection := by
    intro x
    rw [P.network_label_projection]
    exact P.projection_lift (N.entry x) x.val
  choice_projection := by
    intro v z hz
    have hproj : node_domain_projection target Subtype.val =
        fun w : {v // P.presentation.Reached v} => P.projection w.val :=
      funext P.network_label_projection
    simpa only [hproj] using P.network_choice_projection v z hz
  edge_domain_eq := by
    intro v w
    simpa only [P.network_label_projection] using P.network_edge_domain_eq v w

/-- The constructed exact refinement is an allowed one-step network refinement. -/
def allowed_network_refinement : NetworkRefinement N P.network :=
  .node_domain P.network_refinement

end NodePartitionData
end
end formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks

import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks.path_matrix
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks.network_readouts

namespace formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_04_operator_chain_calculus

variable {X V W : Type} {bot : X}

namespace FiniteOperatorNetwork

variable (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V)

/--
OET anchor: h-374f884cd4d69e88
**§ #h-374f884cd4d69e88（路径分段算子表达）**
A network-indexed accessor view records each reachable path domain and chain.
The common untagged value space in `network_expression_readouts` discards these
indices and retains only the input pieces and complete composites.
-/
structure PathSegmentExpression where
  domain : N.ReachablePath → Set X
  chain : N.ReachablePath → Operator X bot

/--
OET anchor: h-374f884cd4d69e88
**§ #h-374f884cd4d69e88（路径分段算子表达）**
The concrete path segment expression induced by a network.
-/
noncomputable def path_segment_expression : PathSegmentExpression N where
  domain := fun p => N.path_domain p.nodes
  chain := fun p => N.path_chain p.nodes

/--
OET anchor: h-56edb9917107efcd
**命题 #h-56edb9917107efcd（路径分解与可达路径有限性，路径分段表达）**
On every path segment, the network extensional operator is locally equivalent
to the path-chain operator selected by the segment expression.
-/
theorem path_segment_expression_local_equivalent
    (p : N.ReachablePath) :
    LocalEquivalent N.extensional_operator
      ((N.path_segment_expression).chain p)
      ((N.path_segment_expression).domain p) := by
  simpa [path_segment_expression] using
    N.local_equivalent_extensional_path_chain p

/--
OET anchor: h-adb38f8458662a70
**§ #h-adb38f8458662a70（节点实际输入域）**
The actual input domain of a node consists of current inputs obtained
before occurrences of that node along reachable paths, restricted to the
node's local operator domain.
-/
def node_actual_input_domain (β : V) : Set X :=
  {y | ∃ (x : {x : X // x ∈ N.U}) (pref suffix : List V),
    N.path_of x = pref ++ β :: suffix ∧
      y = N.chain_eval_nodes pref x.val ∧ y ∈ N.node_dom β}

/--
OET anchor: h-adb38f8458662a70
**§ #h-adb38f8458662a70（节点实际输入域）**
The actual input domain is a subdomain of the corresponding local
operator domain.
-/
theorem node_actual_input_domain_subset_node_dom (β : V) :
    N.node_actual_input_domain β ⊆ N.node_dom β := by
  intro y hy
  rcases hy with ⟨_x, _prefix, _suffix, _hpath, _hy, hydom⟩
  exact hydom

/--
OET anchor: h-adb38f8458662a70
**§ #h-adb38f8458662a70（有效约化网络）**
The local operator used by the effective reduction at a node is the original
local operator restricted to the actual input domain.
-/
noncomputable def effective_node_operator (β : V) : Operator X bot :=
  restrict_operator (N.node_op β) (N.node_actual_input_domain β)

/--
OET anchor: h-adb38f8458662a70
**§ #h-adb38f8458662a70（有效约化网络）**
The domain of an effective node operator is exactly the actual input domain.
-/
theorem dom_effective_node_operator_eq (β : V) :
    dom (N.effective_node_operator β) =
      N.node_actual_input_domain β := by
  exact dom_restrict_operator_eq (N.node_op β)
    (N.node_actual_input_domain β)
    (N.node_actual_input_domain_subset_node_dom β)

/--
OET anchor: h-e84d11a2bc70b939
**命题 #h-e84d11a2bc70b939（有效约化保持外延，局域算子逐点一致）**
On the actual input domain of a node, the effective local operator agrees
pointwise with the original local operator.
-/
theorem effective_node_operator_apply_eq (β : V) :
    ∀ x ∈ N.node_actual_input_domain β,
      (N.effective_node_operator β).func x = (N.node_op β).func x := by
  intro x hx
  exact restrict_operator_apply_of_mem (N.node_op β)
    (N.node_actual_input_domain β) hx

/--
OET anchor: h-e84d11a2bc70b939
**命题 #h-e84d11a2bc70b939（有效约化保持外延，局域算子局部等价）**
The effective local operator and the original local operator are locally
equivalent on the actual input domain.
-/
theorem effective_node_operator_local_equivalent (β : V) :
    LocalEquivalent (N.effective_node_operator β) (N.node_op β)
      (N.node_actual_input_domain β) := by
  intro x hx
  exact N.effective_node_operator_apply_eq β x hx

/--
OET anchor: h-31fdfdb343da7ff2
**命题 #h-31fdfdb343da7ff2（标记分段算子表达决定有效网络）**
This network-indexed accessor view records each path domain and ordered
node-label/operator factors. The common value space is implemented separately
in `network_expression_readouts`; only its expression data survive there.
The chain and label list below are derived from one factor list.
-/
structure TaggedPathSegmentExpression where
  domain : N.ReachablePath → Set X
  factors : N.ReachablePath → List (V × Operator X bot)

/-- The ordered node labels derived from a tagged path segment expression. -/
def TaggedPathSegmentExpression.tags
    {N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V}
    (E : TaggedPathSegmentExpression N) (p : N.ReachablePath) : List V :=
  (E.factors p).map Prod.fst

/-- The ordered local operators derived from a tagged path segment expression. -/
def TaggedPathSegmentExpression.operators
    {N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V}
    (E : TaggedPathSegmentExpression N) (p : N.ReachablePath) :
    List (Operator X bot) :=
  (E.factors p).map Prod.snd

/-- The path-chain operator obtained by composing the ordered factors. -/
noncomputable def TaggedPathSegmentExpression.chain
    {N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V}
    (E : TaggedPathSegmentExpression N) (p : N.ReachablePath) : Operator X bot :=
  OperatorChain (E.operators p).reverse

/--
OET anchor: h-31fdfdb343da7ff2
**命题 #h-31fdfdb343da7ff2（标记分段算子表达决定有效网络）**
The concrete tagged segment expression induced by a network.
-/
noncomputable def tagged_path_segment_expression :
    TaggedPathSegmentExpression N where
  domain := fun p => N.path_domain p.nodes
  factors := fun p => p.nodes.map fun β => (β, N.node_op β)

/--
OET anchor: h-31fdfdb343da7ff2
**命题 #h-31fdfdb343da7ff2（标记分段算子表达决定有效网络，路径域读出）**
The tagged segment expression reads out the original path domain on every
reachable path.
-/
theorem tagged_path_segment_expression_domain_eq (p : N.ReachablePath) :
    N.tagged_path_segment_expression.domain p = N.path_domain p.nodes := rfl

/--
OET anchor: h-31fdfdb343da7ff2
**命题 #h-31fdfdb343da7ff2（标记分段算子表达决定有效网络，有序因子读出）**
The tagged segment expression reads out the ordered node-label/operator
factor list on every reachable path.
-/
theorem tagged_path_segment_expression_factors_eq (p : N.ReachablePath) :
    N.tagged_path_segment_expression.factors p =
      p.nodes.map fun β => (β, N.node_op β) := rfl

/--
OET anchor: h-31fdfdb343da7ff2
**命题 #h-31fdfdb343da7ff2（标记分段算子表达决定有效网络，路径链读出）**
The tagged segment expression reads out the original path-chain operator on
every reachable path.
-/
theorem tagged_path_segment_expression_chain_eq (p : N.ReachablePath) :
    N.tagged_path_segment_expression.chain p = N.path_chain p.nodes := by
  simp [tagged_path_segment_expression, TaggedPathSegmentExpression.chain,
    TaggedPathSegmentExpression.operators, path_chain, Function.comp_def]

/--
OET anchor: h-31fdfdb343da7ff2
**命题 #h-31fdfdb343da7ff2（标记分段算子表达决定有效网络，节点标签读出）**
The tagged segment expression reads out the ordered node labels on every
reachable path.
-/
theorem tagged_path_segment_expression_tags_eq (p : N.ReachablePath) :
    N.tagged_path_segment_expression.tags p = p.nodes := by
  simp [tagged_path_segment_expression, TaggedPathSegmentExpression.tags,
    Function.comp_def]

/-- The entry block reconstructed from path domains and first node labels. -/
def tagged_recovered_entry_domain (β : V) : Set X :=
  {x | ∃ p : N.ReachablePath,
    x ∈ N.path_domain p.nodes ∧ p.nodes.head? = some β}

/-- The first node of a terminal path is its prescribed starting node. -/
theorem terminal_path_head_eq {node_op : V → Operator X bot}
    {choice : V → X → OutputChoice V} {β : V} {y : X} {p : List V}
    (h : TerminalPathFrom node_op choice β y p) : p.head? = some β := by
  cases h <;> rfl

/--
On a terminal path, a `next γ` decision at an occurring prefix forces the next
stored label to be `γ`.
-/
theorem terminal_path_suffix_of_next_at_prefix
    {node_op : V → Operator X bot} {choice : V → X → OutputChoice V}
    {start β γ : V} {x : X} {path pref suffix : List V}
    (hpath : TerminalPathFrom node_op choice start x path)
    (hdecomp : path = pref ++ β :: suffix)
    (hnext :
      choice β
        ((node_op β).func (chain_eval_nodes_core node_op pref x)) =
          OutputChoice.next γ) :
    ∃ tail : List V, suffix = γ :: tail := by
  induction hpath generalizing pref β suffix γ with
  | @stop start x hstop =>
      cases pref with
      | nil =>
          have hparts := List.cons.inj hdecomp
          have hstart : start = β := hparts.1
          have hsuffix : suffix = [] := hparts.2.symm
          subst β
          subst suffix
          have hcontra : OutputChoice.stop = OutputChoice.next γ :=
            hstop.symm.trans hnext
          cases hcontra
      | cons a pref =>
          have hlen := congrArg List.length hdecomp
          simp at hlen
  | @next start target x rest hfirst hrest ih =>
      cases pref with
      | nil =>
          have hparts := List.cons.inj hdecomp
          have hstart : start = β := hparts.1
          have hsuffix : rest = suffix := hparts.2
          subst β
          subst suffix
          have htarget : target = γ :=
            OutputChoice.next.inj (hfirst.symm.trans hnext)
          subst γ
          cases hrest with
          | stop _ => exact ⟨[], rfl⟩
          | next _ _ => exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
      | cons a pref =>
          have hparts := List.cons.inj hdecomp
          have hstart : start = a := hparts.1
          have htail : rest = pref ++ β :: suffix := hparts.2
          subst a
          exact ih htail (by
            simpa [chain_eval_nodes_core] using hnext)

/-- Two adjacent labels on a terminal path determine the corresponding
successor decision at the preceding prefix. -/
theorem terminal_path_choice_at_adjacent_prefix
    {node_op : V → Operator X bot} {choice : V → X → OutputChoice V}
    {start β γ : V} {x : X} {path pref suffix : List V}
    (hpath : TerminalPathFrom node_op choice start x path)
    (hdecomp : path = pref ++ β :: γ :: suffix) :
    choice β ((node_op β).func (chain_eval_nodes_core node_op pref x)) =
      OutputChoice.next γ := by
  induction hpath generalizing pref β γ suffix with
  | @stop start x hstop =>
      have hlen := congrArg List.length hdecomp
      simp at hlen
      omega
  | @next start target x rest hfirst hrest ih =>
      cases pref with
      | nil =>
          simp only [List.nil_append] at hdecomp
          have hparts := List.cons.inj hdecomp
          have hstart : start = β := hparts.1
          have hrest_eq : rest = γ :: suffix := hparts.2
          subst β
          have hhead := terminal_path_head_eq hrest
          rw [hrest_eq] at hhead
          have htarget : target = γ := (Option.some.inj hhead).symm
          subst target
          simpa [chain_eval_nodes_core] using hfirst
      | cons a pref =>
          simp only [List.cons_append] at hdecomp
          have hparts := List.cons.inj hdecomp
          have hstart : start = a := hparts.1
          have htail : rest = pref ++ β :: γ :: suffix := hparts.2
          subst a
          simpa [chain_eval_nodes_core] using ih htail

/-- Prefix evaluation respects concatenation of node lists. -/
theorem chain_eval_nodes_core_append (node_op : V → Operator X bot)
    (left right : List V) (x : X) :
    chain_eval_nodes_core node_op (left ++ right) x =
      chain_eval_nodes_core node_op right
        (chain_eval_nodes_core node_op left x) := by
  induction left generalizing x with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons β rest ih =>
      simp only [List.cons_append, chain_eval_nodes_core]
      exact ih ((node_op β).func x)

/-- Every reachable node has a nonempty actual input domain. -/
theorem node_actual_input_domain_nonempty (β : V) :
    (N.node_actual_input_domain β).Nonempty := by
  rcases N.node_reachable β with ⟨x, hβ⟩
  let p : N.ReachablePath :=
    ⟨N.path_of x, ⟨x.val, x.property, rfl⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := List.get_of_mem hβ
  let w : N.PathPosition := ⟨p, n⟩
  rcases N.path_position_input_domain_nonempty w with ⟨y, hy⟩
  refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
  rw [← N.tagged_recovered_node_input_domain_eq β]
  refine ⟨p, n, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [p] using hn
  · simpa [path_factor_input_domain, path_position_input_domain, w] using hy

/-- Every source input belongs to the actual domain of its entry node. -/
theorem entry_mem_node_actual_input_domain
    (x : {x : X // x ∈ N.U}) :
    x.val ∈ N.node_actual_input_domain (N.entry x) := by
  let p : N.ReachablePath :=
    ⟨N.path_of x, ⟨x.val, x.property, rfl⟩⟩
  have hlen : 0 < p.nodes.length := by
    simpa [p, Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero] using N.path_nonempty x
  let n : Fin p.nodes.length := ⟨0, hlen⟩
  have hlabel : p.nodes.get n = N.entry x := by
    have hne : p.nodes ≠ [] := List.ne_nil_of_length_pos hlen
    have hhead := terminal_path_head_eq (N.path_terminal x)
    have hhead_value : p.nodes.head hne = N.entry x := by
      apply Option.some.inj
      calc
        some (p.nodes.head hne) = p.nodes.head? :=
          (List.head?_eq_some_head hne).symm
        _ = some (N.entry x) := by simpa [p] using hhead
    have hget : p.nodes.head hne = p.nodes.get ⟨0, hlen⟩ := by
      simpa [List.get_eq_getElem] using List.head_eq_getElem_zero hne
    exact hget.symm.trans hhead_value
  rw [← N.tagged_recovered_node_input_domain_eq (N.entry x)]
  refine ⟨p, n, hlabel, x.val, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨x.property, rfl⟩
  · simp [p, n,
      FiniteOperatorNetwork.chain_eval_nodes, chain_eval_nodes_core]

/-- A realised successor transition lands in the successor's actual domain. -/
theorem next_output_mem_node_actual_input_domain
    {β γ : V} {y : X}
    (hy : y ∈ N.node_actual_input_domain β)
    (hnext : N.choice β ((N.node_op β).func y) = OutputChoice.next γ) :
    (N.node_op β).func y ∈ N.node_actual_input_domain γ := by
  rcases hy with ⟨x, pref, suffix, hpath, hy, hydom⟩
  have hnext' :
      N.choice β
          ((N.node_op β).func (N.chain_eval_nodes pref x.val)) =
        OutputChoice.next γ := by
    simpa [hy] using hnext
  rcases terminal_path_suffix_of_next_at_prefix
      (N.path_terminal x) hpath hnext' with ⟨tail, hsuffix⟩
  refine ⟨x, pref ++ [β], tail, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hsuffix] at hpath
    simpa [List.append_assoc] using hpath
  · rw [FiniteOperatorNetwork.chain_eval_nodes,
      chain_eval_nodes_core_append]
    simp [FiniteOperatorNetwork.chain_eval_nodes, chain_eval_nodes_core, hy]
  · exact N.choice_next_mem hydom hnext

/-- Restricting every factor to its actual domain preserves each terminal path. -/
theorem terminal_path_effective
    {β : V} {y : X} {path : List V}
    (hy : y ∈ N.node_actual_input_domain β)
    (hpath : TerminalPathFrom N.node_op N.choice β y path) :
    TerminalPathFrom N.effective_node_operator N.choice β y path := by
  induction hpath with
  | @stop β y hstop =>
      have heq := N.effective_node_operator_apply_eq β y hy
      apply TerminalPathFrom.stop
      simpa [heq] using hstop
  | @next β γ y rest hnext hrest ih =>
      have heq := N.effective_node_operator_apply_eq β y hy
      have hy' := N.next_output_mem_node_actual_input_domain hy hnext
      apply TerminalPathFrom.next
      · simpa [heq] using hnext
      · simpa [heq] using ih hy'

/-- A list splits at any two adjacent valid positions. -/
theorem list_eq_take_two_get_drop {α : Type} (l : List α) (n : Nat)
    (hn : n + 1 < l.length) :
    l = l.take n ++
      l.get ⟨n, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hn⟩ ::
        l.get ⟨n + 1, hn⟩ :: l.drop (n + 2) := by
  calc
    l = l.take n ++ l.drop n := (List.take_append_drop n l).symm
    _ = l.take n ++
        l.get ⟨n, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hn⟩ :: l.drop (n + 1) := by
      rw [← List.cons_get_drop_succ
        (n := (⟨n, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hn⟩ : Fin l.length))]
    _ = l.take n ++
        l.get ⟨n, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hn⟩ ::
          l.get ⟨n + 1, hn⟩ :: l.drop (n + 2) := by
      rw [← List.cons_get_drop_succ
        (n := (⟨n + 1, hn⟩ : Fin l.length))]

/-- The prefix through a valid position is `take n` followed by that entry. -/
theorem take_succ_eq_take_append_get {α : Type} (l : List α) (n : Nat)
    (hn : n < l.length) :
    l.take (n + 1) = l.take n ++ [l.get ⟨n, hn⟩] := by
  rw [← List.concat_eq_append]
  exact (List.take_concat_get (l := l) (i := n) hn).symm

/-- Prefix evaluation with an arbitrary node-operator family. -/
theorem chain_eval_nodes_core_take_succ (node_op : V → Operator X bot)
    {nodes : List V} {n : Nat} (hn : n < nodes.length) (x : X) :
    chain_eval_nodes_core node_op (nodes.take (n + 1)) x =
      (node_op (nodes.get ⟨n, hn⟩)).func
        (chain_eval_nodes_core node_op (nodes.take n) x) := by
  induction nodes generalizing n x with
  | nil =>
      cases hn
  | cons β rest ih =>
      cases n with
      | zero =>
          simp [chain_eval_nodes_core]
      | succ n =>
          have hnrest : n < rest.length := by
            simpa using Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp hn
          simpa [chain_eval_nodes_core] using
            ih hnrest ((node_op β).func x)

/-- Evaluation along a stored path using the effectively restricted factors. -/
noncomputable def effective_chain_eval_nodes (nodes : List V) (x : X) : X :=
  chain_eval_nodes_core N.effective_node_operator nodes x

/--
Every effective prefix evaluates exactly as the corresponding original prefix
on its path segment.
-/
theorem effective_prefix_eval_eq (p : N.ReachablePath) {x : X}
    (hx : x ∈ N.path_domain p.nodes) :
    ∀ n : Nat, n ≤ p.nodes.length →
      N.effective_chain_eval_nodes (p.nodes.take n) x =
        N.chain_eval_nodes (p.nodes.take n) x := by
  intro n hn
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simp [effective_chain_eval_nodes, FiniteOperatorNetwork.chain_eval_nodes,
        chain_eval_nodes_core]
  | succ n ih =>
      have hnlt : n < p.nodes.length := by omega
      have heffstep := chain_eval_nodes_core_take_succ
        N.effective_node_operator hnlt x
      have hstep := N.chain_eval_nodes_take_succ hnlt x
      have hprefix := ih (Nat.le_of_lt hnlt)
      have hy_recovered :
          N.chain_eval_nodes (p.nodes.take n) x ∈
            N.tagged_recovered_node_input_domain
              (p.nodes.get ⟨n, hnlt⟩) :=
        ⟨p, ⟨n, hnlt⟩, rfl, x, hx, rfl⟩
      have hy_actual :
          N.chain_eval_nodes (p.nodes.take n) x ∈
            N.node_actual_input_domain (p.nodes.get ⟨n, hnlt⟩) := by
        rw [← N.tagged_recovered_node_input_domain_eq
          (p.nodes.get ⟨n, hnlt⟩)]
        exact hy_recovered
      have hfactor := N.effective_node_operator_apply_eq
        (p.nodes.get ⟨n, hnlt⟩)
        (N.chain_eval_nodes (p.nodes.take n) x) hy_actual
      calc
        N.effective_chain_eval_nodes (p.nodes.take (n + 1)) x =
            (N.effective_node_operator (p.nodes.get ⟨n, hnlt⟩)).func
              (N.effective_chain_eval_nodes (p.nodes.take n) x) := by
          simpa [effective_chain_eval_nodes] using heffstep
        _ = (N.effective_node_operator (p.nodes.get ⟨n, hnlt⟩)).func
              (N.chain_eval_nodes (p.nodes.take n) x) := by
          rw [hprefix]
        _ = (N.node_op (p.nodes.get ⟨n, hnlt⟩)).func
              (N.chain_eval_nodes (p.nodes.take n) x) := hfactor
        _ = N.chain_eval_nodes (p.nodes.take (n + 1)) x := hstep.symm

noncomputable def effective_eval (x : {x : X // x ∈ N.U}) : X :=

-/
def ExtensionalEquivalent
    (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V) (M : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot W) : Prop :=
  N.U = M.U ∧
    LocalEquivalent N.extensional_operator M.extensional_operator N.U

/--
OET anchor: h-2fb93a4e99c7e5f4
**定义（外延等价与有效等价）**
Effective equivalence is isomorphism of tagged segment expressions.
-/
def EffectiveEquivalent
    (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V) (M : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot W) : Prop :=
  Nonempty (TaggedSegmentExpressionIsomorphism N M)

/--
OET anchor: h-2fb93a4e99c7e5f4
**命题 #h-2fb93a4e99c7e5f4（有效等价推出外延等价）**
Effective equivalence of tagged segment expressions implies extensional
equivalence of the induced network operators.
-/
theorem effective_equivalent_implies_extensional
    {N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V} {M : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot W}
    (h : EffectiveEquivalent N M) :
    ExtensionalEquivalent N M := by
  rcases h with ⟨h⟩
  refine ⟨h.source_eq, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  let p : N.ReachablePath :=
    ⟨N.path_of ⟨x, hx⟩, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩⟩
  let q : M.ReachablePath := h.path_equiv p
  have hxNp : x ∈ N.path_domain p.nodes := by
    exact ⟨hx, rfl⟩
  have hxMq : x ∈ M.path_domain q.nodes := by
    have hxMq' :
        x ∈ M.path_domain ((h.path_equiv p).nodes) := by
      rw [← h.path_domain_eq p]
      exact hxNp
    simpa [q] using hxMq'
  rcases hxMq with ⟨hxMU, hMpath⟩
  calc
    N.extensional_operator.func x =
        N.chain_eval_nodes p.nodes x := by
      simpa [p] using
        N.extensional_apply_eq_chain_eval_path ⟨x, hx⟩
    _ = (N.path_chain p.nodes).func x :=
      (N.path_chain_apply_eq_chain_eval_nodes p.nodes x).symm
    _ = (M.path_chain q.nodes).func x := by
      simpa [q] using h.path_chain_local_equiv p x hxNp
    _ = M.chain_eval_nodes q.nodes x :=
      M.path_chain_apply_eq_chain_eval_nodes q.nodes x
    _ = M.chain_eval_nodes (M.path_of ⟨x, hxMU⟩) x := by
      rw [hMpath]
    _ = M.extensional_operator.func x :=
      (M.extensional_apply_eq_chain_eval_path ⟨x, hxMU⟩).symm

/--
OET anchor: h-2fb93a4e99c7e5f4
**命题 #h-2fb93a4e99c7e5f4（有效等价推出外延等价，反向反例）**
On the singleton source in `Fin 2`, one identity node and two serial identity
nodes have the same extensional operator but cannot have isomorphic tagged
segment expressions.
-/
theorem extensional_equivalence_not_implies_effective_counterexample :
    ∃ (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork (Fin 2) 0 Unit)
      (M : FiniteOperatorNetwork (Fin 2) 0 (Fin 2)),
      ExtensionalEquivalent N M ∧ ¬ EffectiveEquivalent N M := by
  classical
  let N : FiniteOperatorNetwork (Fin 2) 0 Unit :=
    NetworkObject.single_node_network
      (id_operator : Operator (Fin 2) 0) fin2_id_operator_ne_bot
  let M : FiniteOperatorNetwork (Fin 2) 0 (Fin 2) :=
    fin2_two_node_id_network.to_finite
  refine ⟨N, M, ?_, ?_⟩
  · constructor
    · ext x
      fin_cases x <;>
        simp [N, M, NetworkObject.single_node_network,
          fin2_two_node_id_network, OperatorNetwork.to_finite, dom, id_operator]
    · intro x hx
      have hext := node_count_not_extensional_invariant
      simpa [N, M] using congrArg (fun op : Operator (Fin 2) 0 => op.func x) hext.1
  · rintro ⟨hiso⟩
    have hcard := Fintype.card_congr hiso.node_equiv
    norm_num at hcard

end FiniteOperatorNetwork

end formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks

import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks.network_identity

namespace formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_04_operator_chain_calculus

variable {X I : Type} {bot : X}

/--
OET anchor: h-4a79b2e15dc90f1a
**定义（非空编号网络表示）**
`FiniteOperatorNetwork` 的非空输入域版本，保留构造时使用的辅助证书。
进入 `NetworkObject` 时只按原始编号数据判断相等；唯一空对象由
`NetworkObject.empty` 表示。
-/
structure NonemptyOperatorNetwork (X : Type) (bot : X) where
  node_count : Nat
  network : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot (Fin node_count)
  source_nonempty : network.U.Nonempty

namespace NonemptyOperatorNetwork

/-- Original data retain the actual finite numbering. Equal data forget only
implementation witnesses, not graph isomorphisms or extensional differences. -/
def presentation_data (N : NonemptyOperatorNetwork X bot) :
    Σ n : Nat, FiniteOperatorNetwork.PresentationData X bot (Fin n) :=
  ⟨N.node_count, N.network.presentation_data⟩

def data_setoid : Setoid (NonemptyOperatorNetwork X bot) where
  r := fun N M => N.presentation_data = M.presentation_data
  iseqv := ⟨fun _ => rfl, fun h => h.symm, fun h₁ h₂ => h₁.trans h₂⟩

/-- Eliminate equality of numbered data into equality on one fixed node type. -/
theorem presentation_data_eq_elim
    {P : NonemptyOperatorNetwork X bot → NonemptyOperatorNetwork X bot → Prop}
    (step : ∀ (n : Nat) (N M : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot (Fin n))
      (hN : N.U.Nonempty) (hM : M.U.Nonempty),
      N.presentation_data = M.presentation_data → P ⟨n, N, hN⟩ ⟨n, M, hM⟩)
    {N M : NonemptyOperatorNetwork X bot}
    (h : N.presentation_data = M.presentation_data) : P N M := by
  rcases N with ⟨n, N, hN⟩
  rcases M with ⟨m, M, hM⟩
  have hn : n = m := congrArg Sigma.fst h
  subst m
  have hd : N.presentation_data = M.presentation_data := by
    simpa only [presentation_data, Sigma.mk.inj_iff, heq_iff_eq, true_and] using h
  exact step n N M hN hM hd

theorem presentation_data_eq_extensional_operator
    {N M : NonemptyOperatorNetwork X bot}
    (h : N.presentation_data = M.presentation_data) :
    N.network.extensional_operator = M.network.extensional_operator := by
  apply presentation_data_eq_elim (P := fun N M =>
    N.network.extensional_operator = M.network.extensional_operator) ?_ h
  intro n N M hN hM hd
  exact FiniteOperatorNetwork.presentation_data_eq_extensional_operator hd

/--
OET anchor: h-b2fb8267687c8372
Encode an arbitrary finite-label representation without identifying its nodes.
-/
noncomputable def encode {V : Type} (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V)
    (hU : N.U.Nonempty) : NonemptyOperatorNetwork X bot :=
  { node_count := N.node_count
    network := N.standard_relabel
    source_nonempty := hU }

theorem encode_extensional_operator {V : Type} (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V)
    (hU : N.U.Nonempty) :
    (encode N hU).network.extensional_operator = N.extensional_operator :=
  N.standard_relabel_preserves.2.1

/--
OET anchor: h-4a79b2e15dc90f1a
**命题（非空网络外延非空）**
非空网络对象的外延算子不是全未定义算子。
-/
theorem extensional_operator_ne_bot (N : NonemptyOperatorNetwork X bot) :
    N.network.extensional_operator ≠ bot_operator := by
  intro h
  rcases N.source_nonempty with ⟨x, hx⟩
  have hxdom : x ∈ dom N.network.extensional_operator := by
    rw [N.network.dom_extensional_operator_eq]
    exact hx
  have hbot : N.network.extensional_operator.func x = bot := by
    have hfun := congrArg (fun op : Operator X bot => op.func x) h
    simpa [bot_operator] using hfun
  exact hxdom hbot

end NonemptyOperatorNetwork

/--
OET anchor: h-038163ee6fa2eddc
**定义（有限编号网络的对象集合）**
The nonempty component identifies precisely equal original numbered data.
Termination witnesses and choices outside node output images are discarded;
different numbered data remain distinct. The empty network is one constructor.
-/
inductive NetworkObject (X : Type) (bot : X) where
  | empty : NetworkObject X bot
  | present : Quotient (NonemptyOperatorNetwork.data_setoid (X := X) (bot := bot)) →
      NetworkObject X bot

namespace NetworkObject

/-- Enter a certified nonempty numbered representation into the object space. -/
def nonempty (N : NonemptyOperatorNetwork X bot) : NetworkObject X bot :=
  present (Quotient.mk _ N)

@[simp] theorem nonempty_ne_empty (N : NonemptyOperatorNetwork X bot) :
    nonempty N ≠ empty := by intro h; cases h

theorem nonempty_eq_iff {N M : NonemptyOperatorNetwork X bot} :
    nonempty N = nonempty M ↔ N.presentation_data = M.presentation_data := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact Quotient.exact (NetworkObject.present.inj h)
  · intro h
    exact congrArg present (Quotient.sound h)

/-- Lift a readout that depends only on the original numbered data. -/
def lift {P : Type} (empty_value : P) (f : NonemptyOperatorNetwork X bot → P)
    (compatible : ∀ N M, N.presentation_data = M.presentation_data → f N = f M) :
    NetworkObject X bot → P
  | empty => empty_value
  | present q => Quotient.lift f compatible q

@[simp] theorem lift_empty {P : Type} (empty_value : P)
    (f : NonemptyOperatorNetwork X bot → P)
    (compatible : ∀ N M, N.presentation_data = M.presentation_data → f N = f M) :
    lift empty_value f compatible empty = empty_value := rfl

@[simp] theorem lift_nonempty {P : Type} (empty_value : P)
    (f : NonemptyOperatorNetwork X bot → P)
    (compatible : ∀ N M, N.presentation_data = M.presentation_data → f N = f M)
    (N : NonemptyOperatorNetwork X bot) :
    lift empty_value f compatible (nonempty N) = f N := rfl

/--
OET anchor: h-4a79b2e15dc90f1a
**定义（算子读出映射）**
空网络读出为 `⊥_op`，非空网络读出为其外延算子。
-/
noncomputable def extensional_operator : NetworkObject X bot → Operator X bot :=
  lift bot_operator (fun N => N.network.extensional_operator)
    (fun _ _ h => NonemptyOperatorNetwork.presentation_data_eq_extensional_operator h)

@[simp] theorem extensional_operator_nonempty (N : NonemptyOperatorNetwork X bot) :
    (nonempty N).extensional_operator = N.network.extensional_operator := rfl

/--
OET anchor: h-4a79b2e15dc90f1a
**命题（空网络外延）**
唯一空网络的外延算子为全未定义算子。
-/
theorem extensional_operator_empty :
    extensional_operator (X := X) (bot := bot) empty = bot_operator :=
  rfl

/--
OET anchor: h-4a79b2e15dc90f1a
**命题（非空网络外延隔离）**
非空网络对象的外延算子不是 `⊥_op`。
-/
theorem extensional_operator_ne_bot_of_ne_empty {N : NetworkObject X bot}
    (hN : N ≠ empty) : N.extensional_operator ≠ bot_operator := by
  cases N with
  | empty =>
      exact (hN rfl).elim
  | present q =>
      induction q using Quotient.inductionOn with
      | h N => exact N.extensional_operator_ne_bot

/--
OET anchor: h-4a79b2e15dc90f1a
**定义（外延网络伪度量）**
网络对象上的伪度量由算子空间伪度量沿算子读出拉回。
-/
noncomputable def extensional_dist (d : X → X → ENNReal)
    (N M : NetworkObject X bot) : ENNReal :=
  op_dist d N.extensional_operator M.extensional_operator

/--
OET anchor: h-4a79b2e15dc90f1a
The componentwise pseudometric and absorbing-point axioms pulled back from
the operator space.  Nonabsorption is supplied separately when constructing
the full extended pseudometric structure. -/
theorem extensional_dist_axioms (d : X → X → ENNReal)
    (dist_self : ∀ x : X, d x x = 0)
    (symm : ∀ x y : X, d x y = d y x)
    (triangle : ∀ x y z : X, d x z ≤ d x y + d y z)
    (dist_bot : ∀ x ≠ bot, d x bot = ⊤) :
    (∀ N : NetworkObject X bot, extensional_dist d N N = 0) ∧
    (∀ N M : NetworkObject X bot,
      extensional_dist d N M = extensional_dist d M N) ∧
    (∀ N M K : NetworkObject X bot,
      extensional_dist d N K ≤ extensional_dist d N M + extensional_dist d M K) ∧
    (∀ N : NetworkObject X bot, N ≠ empty →
      extensional_dist d N empty = ⊤) := by
  rcases op_dist_is_pseudo_metric d dist_self symm triangle dist_bot with
    ⟨hself, hsymm, htri, hbot⟩
  constructor
  · intro N
    exact hself N.extensional_operator
  constructor
  · intro N M
    exact hsymm N.extensional_operator M.extensional_operator
  constructor
  · intro N M K
    exact htri N.extensional_operator M.extensional_operator K.extensional_operator
  · intro N hN
    exact hbot N.extensional_operator (N.extensional_operator_ne_bot_of_ne_empty hN)

/--
OET anchor: h-1fb1b80c5f14f459
**定义（外延等价关系）**
两个网络对象外延等价当且仅当外延算子相等。
-/
def ExtensionalEquivalent (N M : NetworkObject X bot) : Prop :=
  N.extensional_operator = M.extensional_operator

/--
OET anchor: h-1fb1b80c5f14f459
**命题（外延等价关系）**
外延等价是等价关系。
-/
theorem extensional_equivalent_equivalence :
    Equivalence (ExtensionalEquivalent (X := X) (bot := bot)) := by
  constructor
  · intro N
    rfl
  · intro N M h
    exact h.symm
  · intro N M K hNM hMK
    exact hNM.trans hMK

/--
OET anchor: h-1fb1b80c5f14f459
**定义（外延商）**
外延等价给出的商关系。
-/
def extensional_setoid : Setoid (NetworkObject X bot) where
  r := ExtensionalEquivalent
  iseqv := extensional_equivalent_equivalence

/--
OET anchor: h-1fb1b80c5f14f459
**定义（外延商算子读出）**
算子读出在外延商上良定义。
-/
noncomputable def quotient_extensional_operator :
    Quotient (extensional_setoid (X := X) (bot := bot)) → Operator X bot :=
  Quotient.lift extensional_operator (by
    intro N M h
    exact h)

/--
OET anchor: h-1fb1b80c5f14f459
**命题（非空算子定义域）**
非全未定义算子的定义域非空。
-/
theorem dom_nonempty_of_operator_ne_bot (φ : Operator X bot)
    (hφ : φ ≠ bot_operator) : (dom φ).Nonempty := by
  by_contra h
  apply hφ
  ext x
  by_cases hx : φ.func x = bot
  · exact hx
  · exact False.elim (h ⟨x, hx⟩)

/--
OET anchor: h-1fb1b80c5f14f459
**定义（单节点实现）**
任意非全未定义算子先由单节点有限算子网络实现。
-/
noncomputable def single_node_network (φ : Operator X bot)
    (hφ : φ ≠ bot_operator) : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot Unit := by
  classical
  have hdom : (dom φ).Nonempty := dom_nonempty_of_operator_ne_bot φ hφ
  refine
    { U := dom φ
      bot_not_mem := ?_
      node_fintype := inferInstance
      node_op := fun _ => φ
      node_dom_nonempty := fun _ => hdom
      entry := fun _ => ()
      entry_mem := fun x => x.property
      choice := fun _ _ => OutputChoice.stop
      choice_next_mem := ?_
      depth_bound := 1
      path_of := fun _ => [()]
      path_terminal := ?_
      path_length_le_depth := ?_
      node_reachable := ?_ }
  · intro hbot_dom
    exact hbot_dom φ.preserves_bot
  · intro β γ y hy hchoice
    cases hchoice
  · intro x
    exact TerminalPathFrom.stop rfl
  · intro x
    simp
  · intro β
    rcases hdom with ⟨x, hx⟩
    refine ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, ?_⟩
    cases β
    simp

/--
OET anchor: h-1fb1b80c5f14f459
**定义（单节点非空网络对象）**
任意非全未定义算子由单节点非空网络对象实现。
-/
noncomputable def single_node_nonempty_network (φ : Operator X bot)
    (hφ : φ ≠ bot_operator) : NonemptyOperatorNetwork X bot :=
  { node_count := (single_node_network φ hφ).node_count
    network := (single_node_network φ hφ).standard_relabel
    source_nonempty := by
      simpa [single_node_network] using dom_nonempty_of_operator_ne_bot φ hφ }

/--
OET anchor: h-1fb1b80c5f14f459
**命题（单节点实现外延）**
单节点网络的外延算子等于原算子。
-/
theorem single_node_network_extensional_operator_eq
    (φ : Operator X bot) (hφ : φ ≠ bot_operator) :
    (single_node_network φ hφ).extensional_operator = φ := by
  classical
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ dom φ
  · simp [single_node_network, FiniteOperatorNetwork.extensional_operator,
      FiniteOperatorNetwork.eval, chain_eval_nodes_core, hx]
  · have hfx : φ.func x = bot := by
      by_contra hne
      exact hx hne
    simp [single_node_network, FiniteOperatorNetwork.extensional_operator,
      FiniteOperatorNetwork.eval, chain_eval_nodes_core, hx, hfx]

/--
OET anchor: h-1fb1b80c5f14f459
**命题（单节点非空网络对象外延）**
单节点非空网络对象的外延算子等于原算子。
-/
theorem single_node_nonempty_network_extensional_operator_eq
    (φ : Operator X bot) (hφ : φ ≠ bot_operator) :
    (single_node_nonempty_network φ hφ).network.extensional_operator = φ := by
  exact (single_node_network φ hφ).standard_relabel_preserves.2.1.trans
    (single_node_network_extensional_operator_eq φ hφ)

/--
OET anchor: h-4a79b2e15dc90f1a
**命题 #h-4a79b2e15dc90f1a（有限算子网络的外延规范空间）**
Each component pseudometric on the base space pulls back along the extensional
readout to an extended pseudometric on finite network objects.  A one-node
restriction of the identity at a nonabsorbing point supplies the required
nonabsorbing network object.
-/
theorem extensional_pseudo_metric (d : X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot d) :
    ExtendedPseudoMetric (NetworkObject X bot) NetworkObject.empty
      (extensional_dist d) := by
  classical
  rcases hd.nonabsorbing with ⟨z, hz⟩
  let φ : Operator X bot :=
    restrict_operator (id_operator : Operator X bot) ({z} : Set X)
  have hφ : φ ≠ bot_operator := by
    intro h
    have hfun := congrArg (fun op : Operator X bot => op.func z) h
    apply hz
    simpa [φ, restrict_operator, id_operator, bot_operator] using hfun
  let N : NetworkObject X bot :=
    NetworkObject.nonempty (single_node_nonempty_network φ hφ)
  have hN : N ≠ NetworkObject.empty := by
    simp [N]
  rcases extensional_dist_axioms d hd.dist_self hd.symm hd.triangle hd.isolate_bot with
    ⟨hself, hsymm, htriangle, hisolate⟩
  exact
    { nonabsorbing := ⟨N, hN⟩
      dist_self := hself
      symm := hsymm
      triangle := htriangle
      isolate_bot := hisolate }

/--
OET anchor: h-038163ee6fa2eddc
The small coded object space can actually be used again as a network base.
-/
theorem iterated_extensional_pseudo_metric (d : X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot d) :
    ExtendedPseudoMetric
      (NetworkObject (NetworkObject X bot) NetworkObject.empty) NetworkObject.empty
      (extensional_dist (extensional_dist d)) :=
  extensional_pseudo_metric (extensional_dist d) (extensional_pseudo_metric d hd)

/--
OET anchor: h-1fb1b80c5f14f459
**命题（算子读出满射）**
每个算子都是某个网络对象的算子读出。
-/
theorem extensional_operator_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (extensional_operator (X := X) (bot := bot)) := by
  intro φ
  by_cases hφ : φ = bot_operator
  · refine ⟨empty, ?_⟩
    simp [extensional_operator, hφ]
  · refine ⟨nonempty (single_node_nonempty_network φ hφ), ?_⟩
    simpa [extensional_operator] using
      single_node_nonempty_network_extensional_operator_eq φ hφ

/--
OET anchor: h-1fb1b80c5f14f459
**命题 #h-1fb1b80c5f14f459（外延商与算子空间）**
算子读出诱导从外延商到算子空间的双射。
-/
theorem quotient_extensional_operator_bijective :
    Function.Bijective
      (quotient_extensional_operator (X := X) (bot := bot)) := by
  constructor
  · intro Q R hQR
    refine Quotient.inductionOn₂ Q R ?_ hQR
    intro N M hNM
    exact Quotient.sound hNM
  · intro φ
    rcases extensional_operator_surjective (X := X) (bot := bot) φ with
      ⟨N, hN⟩
    exact ⟨Quotient.mk _ N, hN⟩

/--
OET anchor: h-1fb1b80c5f14f459
**命题 #h-1fb1b80c5f14f459（商读出下的距离等式）**
外延网络伪度量等于商读出后在算子空间中的伪度量。
-/
theorem extensional_dist_eq_quotient_operator_dist
    (d : X → X → ENNReal) (N M : NetworkObject X bot) :
    extensional_dist d N M =
      op_dist d
        (quotient_extensional_operator
          (Quotient.mk (extensional_setoid (X := X) (bot := bot)) N))
        (quotient_extensional_operator
          (Quotient.mk (extensional_setoid (X := X) (bot := bot)) M)) := by
  rfl

end NetworkObject

end formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks

import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks.network_relabeling
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks.network_routing

namespace formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations

namespace FiniteOperatorNetwork

variable {X V : Type} {bot : X}

/-- The original network data on a fixed node type. Empty entry and edge domains
encode absent entries and edges. Termination bounds, selected terminal paths and
routing choices outside local output images are not part of these data. -/
structure PresentationData (X : Type) (bot : X) (V : Type) where
  U : Set X
  node_op : V → Operator X bot
  entry_domain : V → Set X
  edge_domain : V → V → Set X

/-- Forget implementation witnesses without identifying different node labels. -/
def presentation_data (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V) : PresentationData X bot V :=
  ⟨N.U, N.node_op, N.entry_domain, N.edge_domain⟩

variable {N M : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V}

theorem presentation_data_eq_source (h : N.presentation_data = M.presentation_data) :
    N.U = M.U := congrArg PresentationData.U h

theorem presentation_data_eq_node_op (h : N.presentation_data = M.presentation_data) :
    N.node_op = M.node_op := congrArg PresentationData.node_op h

theorem presentation_data_eq_entry_domain
    (h : N.presentation_data = M.presentation_data) :
    N.entry_domain = M.entry_domain := congrArg PresentationData.entry_domain h

theorem presentation_data_eq_edge_domain
    (h : N.presentation_data = M.presentation_data) :
    N.edge_domain = M.edge_domain := congrArg PresentationData.edge_domain h

/-- Original edge data determine routing on every local output image, including
outputs not reached from the network input domain. -/
theorem presentation_data_eq_choice
    (h : N.presentation_data = M.presentation_data) (v : V) (z : X)
    (hz : z ∈ N.node_image v) : N.choice v z = M.choice v z := by
  have hop := presentation_data_eq_node_op h
  have hzM : z ∈ M.node_image v := by
    change z ∈ (M.node_op v).func '' dom (M.node_op v)
    change z ∈ (N.node_op v).func '' dom (N.node_op v) at hz
    simpa only [hop] using hz
  have hnext (w : V) : N.choice v z = .next w ↔ M.choice v z = .next w := by
    have hed : (z ∈ N.edge_domain v w) ↔ z ∈ M.edge_domain v w := by
      rw [presentation_data_eq_edge_domain h]
    change (z ∈ N.node_image v ∧ N.choice v z = .next w) ↔
      (z ∈ M.node_image v ∧ M.choice v z = .next w) at hed
    simpa only [hz, hzM, true_and] using hed
  cases hn : N.choice v z with
  | stop =>
      cases hm : M.choice v z with
      | stop => rfl
      | next w =>
          have hc := (hnext w).mpr hm
          simp [hn] at hc
  | next w => exact ((hnext w).mp hn).symm

theorem presentation_data_eq_terminal_path
    (h : N.presentation_data = M.presentation_data) {v : V} {x : X} {p : List V}
    (hx : x ∈ dom (N.node_op v))
    (hp : TerminalPathFrom N.node_op N.choice v x p) :
    TerminalPathFrom M.node_op M.choice v x p := by
  have hop := presentation_data_eq_node_op h
  induction hp with
  | @stop v x hs =>
      apply TerminalPathFrom.stop
      rw [← hop, ← presentation_data_eq_choice h v ((N.node_op v).func x) ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩]
      exact hs
  | @next v w x rest hs ht ih =>
      apply TerminalPathFrom.next (γ := w)
      · rw [← hop, ← presentation_data_eq_choice h v ((N.node_op v).func x) ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩]
        exact hs
      · simpa only [← hop] using ih (N.choice_next_mem hx hs)

theorem presentation_data_eq_entry
    (h : N.presentation_data = M.presentation_data) (x : N.U) :
    N.entry x = M.entry ⟨x.val, (presentation_data_eq_source h) ▸ x.property⟩ := by
  have hx : x.val ∈ N.entry_domain (N.entry x) := ⟨x.property, rfl⟩
  rw [presentation_data_eq_entry_domain h] at hx
  rcases hx with ⟨hx, he⟩
  exact he.symm

/-- The complete path is determined by the original network data, not by the
stored termination witness. -/
theorem presentation_data_eq_path_of
    (h : N.presentation_data = M.presentation_data) (x : N.U) :
    N.path_of x = M.path_of ⟨x.val, (presentation_data_eq_source h) ▸ x.property⟩ := by
  have ht := presentation_data_eq_terminal_path h (N.entry_mem x) (N.path_terminal x)
  rw [presentation_data_eq_entry h x] at ht
  exact terminal_path_unique ht (M.path_terminal _)

theorem presentation_data_eq_path_domain
    (h : N.presentation_data = M.presentation_data) (p : List V) :
    N.path_domain p = M.path_domain p := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx, hp⟩
    refine ⟨(presentation_data_eq_source h) ▸ hx, ?_⟩
    exact (presentation_data_eq_path_of h ⟨x, hx⟩).symm.trans hp
  · rintro ⟨hx, hp⟩
    refine ⟨(presentation_data_eq_source h.symm) ▸ hx, ?_⟩
    exact (presentation_data_eq_path_of h.symm ⟨x, hx⟩).symm.trans hp

theorem presentation_data_eq_extensional_operator
    (h : N.presentation_data = M.presentation_data) :
    N.extensional_operator = M.extensional_operator := by
  classical
  have hU := presentation_data_eq_source h
  have hop := presentation_data_eq_node_op h
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ N.U
  · have hxM : x ∈ M.U := hU ▸ hx
    simp only [extensional_operator, dif_pos hx, dif_pos hxM, eval]
    rw [presentation_data_eq_path_of h ⟨x, hx⟩, hop]
  · have hxM : x ∉ M.U := by simpa only [← hU] using hx
    simp [extensional_operator, hx, hxM]

end FiniteOperatorNetwork
end formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks

import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks.operator_network

namespace formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations
open FiniteOperatorNetwork

noncomputable section
variable {X V : Type} {bot : X}

/-- A finite terminating network before removal of unreachable nodes.
All routing and termination obligations are retained; only nonredundancy is absent. -/
structure FiniteNetworkPresentation (X : Type) (bot : X) (V : Type) where
  U : Set X
  bot_not_mem : bot ∉ U
  node_fintype : Fintype V
  node_op : V → Operator X bot
  node_dom_nonempty : ∀ β, (dom (node_op β)).Nonempty
  entry : U → V
  entry_mem : ∀ x : U, x.val ∈ dom (node_op (entry x))
  choice : V → X → OutputChoice V
  choice_next_mem : ∀ {β γ y}, y ∈ dom (node_op β) →
    choice β ((node_op β).func y) = .next γ → (node_op β).func y ∈ dom (node_op γ)
  depth_bound : Nat
  path_of : U → List V
  path_terminal : ∀ x : U, TerminalPathFrom node_op choice (entry x) x.val (path_of x)
  path_length_le_depth : ∀ x : U, (path_of x).length ≤ depth_bound

private theorem terminal_path_start_mem
    {op : V → Operator X bot} {choice : V → X → OutputChoice V}
    {v x p} (h : TerminalPathFrom op choice v x p) : v ∈ p := by
  cases h <;> simp

/-- Delete transitions whose destination was removed. -/
def prune_choice (P : V → Prop) (choice : V → X → OutputChoice V)
    (v : {v // P v}) (x : X) : OutputChoice {v // P v} := by
  classical
  exact match choice v.val x with
    | .stop => .stop
    | .next w => if h : P w then .next ⟨w, h⟩ else .stop

/-- Every edge between retained labels is preserved on its entire domain,
including values that never arise during entrance evaluation. -/
theorem prune_choice_next_iff (P : V → Prop) (choice : V → X → OutputChoice V)
    (v w : {v // P v}) (x : X) :
    prune_choice P choice v x = .next w ↔ choice v.val x = .next w.val := by
  classical
  cases hc : choice v.val x with
  | stop => simp [prune_choice, hc]
  | next u =>
    by_cases hu : P u
    · simp [prune_choice, hc, hu, Subtype.ext_iff]
    · simp only [prune_choice, hc, dif_neg hu, reduceCtorEq, false_iff,
        OutputChoice.next.injEq]
      intro heq
      exact hu (heq ▸ w.property)

private theorem terminal_path_prune
    (P : V → Prop) (op : V → Operator X bot) (choice : V → X → OutputChoice V)
    {v x p} (h : TerminalPathFrom op choice v x p) (hp : ∀ w ∈ p, P w) :
    TerminalPathFrom (fun w : {w // P w} => op w.val) (prune_choice P choice)
      ⟨v, hp v (terminal_path_start_mem h)⟩ x
      (p.pmap (fun w hw => (⟨w, hw⟩ : {w // P w})) hp) := by
  classical
  induction h with
  | stop hs =>
    apply TerminalPathFrom.stop
    simp [prune_choice, hs]
  | @next v w x rest hs ht ih =>
    have hrest : ∀ w ∈ rest, P w := fun w hw => hp w (by simp [hw])
    have hw : P w := hrest w (terminal_path_start_mem ht)
    apply TerminalPathFrom.next (γ := ⟨w, hw⟩)
    · simp [prune_choice, hs, hw]
    · exact ih hrest

namespace FiniteNetworkPresentation
variable (N : FiniteNetworkPresentation X bot V)

/-- A presentation whose nodes all occur is already a finite network.
This adds only the nonredundancy proof, without changing any operational data. -/
def to_finite_network (hreach : ∀ v, ∃ x : N.U, v ∈ N.path_of x) :
    FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V where
  U := N.U
  bot_not_mem := N.bot_not_mem
  node_fintype := N.node_fintype
  node_op := N.node_op
  node_dom_nonempty := N.node_dom_nonempty
  entry := N.entry
  entry_mem := N.entry_mem
  choice := N.choice
  choice_next_mem := N.choice_next_mem
  depth_bound := N.depth_bound
  path_of := N.path_of
  path_terminal := N.path_terminal
  path_length_le_depth := N.path_length_le_depth
  node_reachable := hreach

/-- The output on the input domain, completed by the absorbing point outside it. -/
def extensional_operator : Operator X bot := by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun x => if hx : x ∈ N.U then
    chain_eval_nodes_core N.node_op (N.path_of ⟨x, hx⟩) x else bot, ?_⟩
  simp [N.bot_not_mem]

/-- Exactly the nodes visited by source inputs. -/
def Reached (v : V) : Prop := ∃ x : N.U, v ∈ N.path_of x

/-- OET anchor: h-ced8c7236326e104
Reachable-node pruning retains all original local operators and removes only
unreachable node labels and transitions to those labels. -/
def prune : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot {v // N.Reached v} := by
  classical
  letI := N.node_fintype
  exact {
    U := N.U
    bot_not_mem := N.bot_not_mem
    node_fintype := inferInstance
    node_op := fun v => N.node_op v.val
    node_dom_nonempty := fun v => N.node_dom_nonempty v.val
    entry := fun x => ⟨N.entry x, x, terminal_path_start_mem (N.path_terminal x)⟩
    entry_mem := N.entry_mem
    choice := prune_choice N.Reached N.choice
    choice_next_mem := by
      intro v w y hy hc
      dsimp [prune_choice] at hc
      split at hc
      · contradiction
      · rename_i u heq
        split at hc
        · simp only [OutputChoice.next.injEq] at hc
          cases hc
          exact N.choice_next_mem hy heq
        · contradiction
    depth_bound := N.depth_bound
    path_of := fun x => (N.path_of x).pmap (fun v hv => ⟨v, hv⟩)
      (fun v hv => ⟨x, hv⟩)
    path_terminal := fun x => terminal_path_prune N.Reached N.node_op N.choice
      (N.path_terminal x) (fun v hv => ⟨x, hv⟩)
    path_length_le_depth := by intro x; simpa using N.path_length_le_depth x
    node_reachable := by
      rintro ⟨v, x, hv⟩
      refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
      simp only [List.mem_pmap]
      exact ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
  }

/-- OET anchor: h-ced8c7236326e104
Pruning preserves the complete sequence of visited node labels. -/
@[simp] theorem prune_path_labels (x : N.U) :
    (N.prune.path_of x).map Subtype.val = N.path_of x := by
  simp [prune, List.map_pmap]

private theorem eval_pmap (p : List V) (hp : ∀ v ∈ p, N.Reached v) (x : X) :
    chain_eval_nodes_core (fun v : {v // N.Reached v} => N.node_op v.val)
      (p.pmap (fun v hv => ⟨v, hv⟩) hp) x = chain_eval_nodes_core N.node_op p x := by
  induction p generalizing x with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons v rest ih => exact ih _ _

/-- OET anchor: h-ced8c7236326e104
Pruning preserves each input's terminal output. -/
theorem prune_eval (x : N.U) :
    N.prune.eval x = chain_eval_nodes_core N.node_op (N.path_of x) x.val := by
  exact N.eval_pmap _ _ _

/-- OET anchor: h-ced8c7236326e104
Pruning preserves the absorbing-point-completed extensional operator. -/
theorem prune_extensional_operator_eq :
    N.prune.extensional_operator = N.extensional_operator := by
  classical
  apply Operator.ext
  funext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ N.U
  · simpa only [FiniteOperatorNetwork.extensional_operator, extensional_operator,
      prune, dif_pos hx] using N.prune_eval ⟨x, hx⟩
  · simp [FiniteOperatorNetwork.extensional_operator, extensional_operator, prune, hx]

end FiniteNetworkPresentation
end
end formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks

import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations.operator_space
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks.network_extensional_space
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_03_operator_local_degeneracy.mapping_entropy
import Mathlib.Data.ENNReal.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Card
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Powerset
import Mathlib.Tactic

namespace formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_03_operator_local_degeneracy
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_04_operator_chain_calculus

open scoped BigOperators

variable {X I : Type} {bot : X}

/--
OET anchor: h-cc601faacb6105b5
**注 #h-cc601faacb6105b5（节点数不是外延不变量）**
`Fin 2` 上的恒等算子不是全未定义算子。
-/
theorem fin2_id_operator_ne_bot :
    (id_operator : Operator (Fin 2) 0) ≠ bot_operator := by
  intro h
  have hfun := congrArg (fun φ : Operator (Fin 2) 0 => φ.func (1 : Fin 2)) h
  norm_num [id_operator, bot_operator] at hfun

/--
OET anchor: h-cc601faacb6105b5
**注 #h-cc601faacb6105b5（节点数不是外延不变量）**
`Fin 2` 上由两个串联恒等节点构成的网络。
-/
noncomputable def fin2_two_node_id_network : OperatorNetwork (Fin 2) 0 (Fin 2) := by
  classical
  let one : Fin 2 := 1
  refine
    { U := {one}
      bot_not_mem := ?_
      node_fintype := inferInstance
      node_op := fun _ => id_operator
      node_dom_nonempty := ?_
      entry := fun _ => 0
      entry_mem := ?_
      choice := fun β z =>
        if β = (0 : Fin 2) then
          if z = one then OutputChoice.next (1 : Fin 2) else OutputChoice.stop
        else OutputChoice.stop
      choice_next_mem := ?_
      rank := fun β => if β = (0 : Fin 2) then 1 else 0
      choice_next_rank := ?_
      node_reachable := ?_ }
  · intro hbot
    simp [one] at hbot
  · intro β
    exact ⟨one, by simp [dom, id_operator, one]⟩
  · intro x
    have hxone : x.val = one := by
      exact Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp x.property
    simp [dom, id_operator, hxone, one]
  · intro β γ y hy hchoice
    dsimp [id_operator, dom] at hy ⊢
    by_cases hβ : β = (0 : Fin 2)
    · by_cases hyone : y = one
      · simp [hβ, hyone, one] at hchoice
        simp [hyone, one]
      · simp [id_operator, hβ, hyone] at hchoice
    · simp [hβ] at hchoice
  · intro β γ y hy hchoice
    by_cases hβ : β = (0 : Fin 2)
    · by_cases hyone : y = one
      · simp [hβ, hyone, one] at hchoice
        fin_cases γ <;> simp [id_operator, hβ] at hchoice ⊢
      · simp [id_operator, hβ, hyone] at hchoice
    · simp [hβ] at hchoice
  · intro β
    refine ⟨⟨one, by simp [one]⟩, ?_⟩
    fin_cases β <;>
      simp [path_with_fuel_core, id_operator, one]

/--
OET anchor: h-cc601faacb6105b5
**注 #h-cc601faacb6105b5（节点数不是外延不变量）**
单节点恒等网络与二节点串联恒等网络外延相同，但节点数不同。
-/
theorem node_count_not_extensional_invariant :
    let N₁ : FiniteOperatorNetwork (Fin 2) 0 Unit := NetworkObject.single_node_network
      (X := Fin 2) (bot := 0) (id_operator : Operator (Fin 2) 0)
      fin2_id_operator_ne_bot
    let N₂ : FiniteOperatorNetwork (Fin 2) 0 (Fin 2) := fin2_two_node_id_network.to_finite
    N₁.extensional_operator = N₂.extensional_operator ∧
      N₁.node_count = 1 ∧ N₂.node_count = 2 ∧
        N₁.node_count ≠ N₂.node_count := by
  classical
  dsimp
  have hN₁ :
      (NetworkObject.single_node_network
        (X := Fin 2) (bot := 0) (id_operator : Operator (Fin 2) 0)
        fin2_id_operator_ne_bot).extensional_operator =
        (id_operator : Operator (Fin 2) 0) :=
    NetworkObject.single_node_network_extensional_operator_eq
      (X := Fin 2) (bot := 0) (id_operator : Operator (Fin 2) 0)
      fin2_id_operator_ne_bot
  have hN₂ :
      fin2_two_node_id_network.to_finite.extensional_operator =
        (id_operator : Operator (Fin 2) 0) := by
    exact fin2_two_node_id_network.to_finite_extensional_operator_eq.trans
      (by
        ext x
        fin_cases x <;>
          simp [OperatorNetwork.extensional_operator, OperatorNetwork.eval,
            OperatorNetwork.eval_from, OperatorNetwork.eval_with_fuel,
            eval_with_fuel_core, fin2_two_node_id_network, id_operator])
  have hN₁_count :
      (NetworkObject.single_node_network
        (X := Fin 2) (bot := 0) (id_operator : Operator (Fin 2) 0)
        fin2_id_operator_ne_bot).node_count = 1 := by
    norm_num [FiniteOperatorNetwork.node_count]
  have hN₂_count : fin2_two_node_id_network.to_finite.node_count = 2 := by
    exact Fintype.card_fin 2
  refine ⟨hN₁.trans hN₂.symm, hN₁_count, hN₂_count, ?_⟩
  rw [hN₁_count, hN₂_count]
  norm_num

end formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks
